译文）184 条: 我把一辆豹2A5(Leopard 2A5)升级成了新的虎式(Tiger)坦克。:) 这很管用——虎式、丘吉尔2(Churchill 2)、两架直升机和我的 F-22 一起，把原本强悍的中国守军一点点啃了下来。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: If our offensive is a major success then the ancient order will be restored and peace talks could begin.
译文）184 条: 如果我方攻势大获成功，古老的秩序就将恢复，和谈也就有望开始。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: If we win this campaign I promise you we shall invade Japan!
译文）184 条: 如果我们打赢这场战役，我向你保证，我们就去进攻日本(Japan)！

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: In a matter of hours the insolence of this country will be no longer a problem!
译文）184 条: 不出几个小时，这个国家的无礼就不再是问题了！

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: In the meantime we cannot let this provocation unpunished!
译文）184 条: 与此同时，我们不能让这次挑衅不了了之！

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: In this folder will be added the usermade scenarios.
译文）184 条: 这个文件夹将用来存放玩家自制剧本。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: It is to be here that we launch the re-conquest of Siberia and the Russian Far East.  A humiliated Russia, ready for vengeance, needs only a spark of hope to rejoin the effort to free Asia.
译文）184 条: 我们将从这里发起对西伯利亚(Siberia)和俄罗斯远东(Russian Far East)的反攻。一个受尽屈辱、蓄势复仇的俄罗斯(Russia)，只需要一点希望的火花，就会重新加入解放亚洲(Asia)的行动。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: It is unfortunate that Americans chose to involve themselves in our domestic problems. We'll need to teach them a lesson.
译文）184 条: 很遗憾，美国人选择插手我们的内部事务。得给他们上一课了。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: It was very interesting starting this scenario out with Japanese, German, French, British and Italian equipment in addition to the South Korean equipment instead of playing it the usual way with American and South Korean equipment.
译文）184 条: 这一关开局时，除韩国的装备外还有日本、德国、法国、英国和意大利的装备可用，而不是照老样子只用美国和韩国的装备，这很有意思。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: It's time to get back to the jungle. In most places our offensive has been stopped and the enemy has recovered sooner than we thought possible.
译文）184 条: 该回到丛林里去了。多数方向上我们的攻势已被挡住，敌人的恢复也比我们预想的要快。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Kirby's AD Theorem came to fruition as my 11 strength leader Eurosam got picked off in spite of having two adjacent AD units.  And that was with only two enemy Wild Weasel air missions.  The temptation to reload was great, but I subsumed it.
译文）184 条: 柯比防空定律(Kirby's AD Theorem)应验了：我那支 11 点兵力、带指挥官的欧罗萨姆(Eurosam)，尽管旁边有两个防空单位，还是被点掉了。而且敌方只出动了两次野鼬鼠(Wild Weasel)空中任务。重开的诱惑很大，但我忍住了。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Led by American forces, the United Nations attempt to halt the People's Republic of China and North Korea in South Korea.  The North Koreans and their allies are preparing to unleash a massive attack to reunite the Korean penninsula once and for all.
译文）184 条: 在美国(America)带领下，联合国(United Nations)试图在韩国(South Korea)阻止中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)与朝鲜(North Korea)。朝鲜及其盟友正准备发动大规模进攻，一举重新统一朝鲜半岛(Korean peninsula)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Led by American forces, the United Nations attempt to halt the People's Republic of China in Siberia.
译文）184 条: 在美国(America)带领下，联合国(United Nations)试图在西伯利亚(Siberia)阻止中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Led by American forces, the United Nations attempt to halt the People's Republic of China in South East Asia then continue to free the Chinese 'satellites.'
译文）184 条: 在美国(America)带领下，联合国(United Nations)试图在东南亚(South East Asia)阻止中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)，随后继续「解放」中国的那些「卫星国」。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Led by American forces, the United Nations attempt to halt the People's Republic of China in South Korea.
译文）184 条: 在美国(America)带领下，联合国(United Nations)试图在韩国(South Korea)阻止中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Losing 'Phuoc-Hai' city means immediate arrest. You familly will have the patriotic duty to pay the invoice of the bullet in your head!
译文）184 条: 丢掉福海(Phuoc-Hai)城，你就立即被捕。你的家人将怀着爱国之情，为你脑袋里那颗子弹买单！

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Lost a leader when Chinese tanks and a helo killed my best recon, but gained two other leaders.
译文）184 条: 中国坦克和直升机干掉了我最棒的侦察单位，折了一员指挥官，不过另外又得了两名指挥官。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Lost yet another Eurosam on T5.  What is that?  About six lost so far?  That must be half of my core units.
译文）184 条: 第 5 回合又丢了一套欧罗萨姆(Eurosam)。这是第几套了？到目前为止丢了大概六套？那差不多是我核心部队的一半了。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Maybe our claims at the United Nations will be heard and will bring some military support...
译文）184 条: 或许我们在联合国(United Nations)的诉求能被听见，带来一些军事支援……

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Mutual artillery support saved at least two artillery units.
译文）184 条: 火炮互相支援，至少救下了两个炮兵单位。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: My Eurofighter Typhoons were everywhere on defense, wild weasel and strike missions and certainly earned their keep.
译文）184 条: 我的台风(Eurofighter Typhoon)战机在防空、野鼬鼠和打击任务中无处不在，绝对物有所值。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: My European Intervention Force has geled rather well.  The tanks and artillery are working in tandem with air assets and infantry.
译文）184 条: 我的欧洲干预部队磨合得相当不错。坦克和火炮与空中力量、步兵配合默契。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: My artillery did well, as usual, with the GCTs working nicely with the AS-90s, the PzH 2000 and the Wegmann LARS purchased during the scenario.  One of my Leopard 2A5s was savaged by Chinese tanks, and that really surprised me.  Still, everywhere else, I applied consistent, yet incredibly not-dazzling pressure on the enemy to obtain a V in about 9 or 10 turns.
译文）184 条: 我的炮兵照例表现出色，GCT 与 AS-90、PzH 2000 以及本关途中买来的 Wegmann LARS 配合得恰到好处。我有一辆豹2A5(Leopard 2A5)被中国坦克咬得很惨，这让我很意外。尽管如此，在其余各处，我始终不紧不慢地施压，大约 9 到 10 个回合就拿了个胜利(V)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: My eastern flank got stalled by the hard-hitting Chinese infantry attacks which the Chinese do so well in this jungle terrain.  But the western flank kept moving like an avalance gathering speed on an oily slope.
译文）184 条: 我的东翼被中国步兵凶猛的进攻顶住了——在这片丛林地形里，他们打这种仗很在行。但西翼一直势如雪崩，在湿滑的斜坡上越滚越快。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: NATO forces were also destroyed and they retreated from Russia altogether.
译文）184 条: 北约(NATO)部队同样被击溃，全部撤出了俄罗斯(Russia)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: No worry to make about UN since WW3 prevents major powers from any direct action.
译文）184 条: 不必担心联合国(UN)——第三次世界大战(WW3)让各大国都无法直接出手。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Now that the main rebellion source has vanished, Vietnam will live now in prosperity thanks to the wise words of the 'Little Red Book' and your divine 'police order' skills!
译文）184 条: 既然叛乱的老巢已经消失，越南(Vietnam)从此将在繁荣中生活——全靠《红宝书》(Little Red Book)的智慧箴言，还有你那神乎其技的「维持秩序」本领！

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Now the putsch has failed allowing peace and order to be restored in Bangladesh.
译文）184 条: 政变已然失败，孟加拉国(Bangladesh)得以恢复和平与秩序。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Now we are forced to leave the country under the protest of UN and very likely a military intervention of USA.
译文）184 条: 现在我们被迫撤离这个国家，联合国(UN)会提出抗议，美国(America)很可能还会军事干预。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Now we can sit at the peace table among UN after we leave a puppet regime in Vietnam...
译文）184 条: 现在我们在越南(Vietnam)留下一个傀儡政权后，就能坐到联合国(UN)的谈判桌旁了……

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Of course our treaty with Bangladesh forces us to intervene to defend the oppressed population...
译文）184 条: 当然，我们与孟加拉国(Bangladesh)的条约迫使我们出手，保护受压迫的人民……

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: On turn 1, I expended all of my air mission points to destroy two long range enemy ADs and bring one down to 1 point.  That would, in theory, free up my Mirage 6000 to dominate the air.  But I don't have any strike aircraft, so I don't really know what good it will do me.  I suspect that I should have bought some British Harriers when I had time.  Or perhaps one of those nice little RAH-66s.
译文）184 条: 第 1 回合，我把空军任务点数全用光，摧毁了两个远程敌方防空单位，还把另一个打到只剩 1 点。理论上，这下我的幻影6000(Mirage 6000)就能称霸天空了。可我没有任何对地攻击机，所以真不知道这有什么用。我猜当时有空的时候，我本该买几架英国的海鹞(Harrier)，或者那种小巧可爱的 RAH-66。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: One VH is hidden, discover it then use heliported infantry to capture the Pakistani HQ hidden in the mountains!
译文）184 条: 有一个胜利点(VH)是隐藏的，找到它，然后用直升机机降步兵夺取藏在山里的巴基斯坦(Pakistan)指挥部！

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Originally we did not intend to capture the whole country but Hainoi still hopes for an external intervention of USA, this cannot happen in any way!
译文）184 条: 我们原本没打算占领整个国家，可河内(Hainoi)仍寄望于美国(America)的外部干预——这绝不允许发生！

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Our successful offensive in Bangladesh must be stopped since Pakistan attacked Punjab in order to avoid the collapse of the rebellion of the puppet regime in Bangladesh.
译文）184 条: 我们在孟加拉国(Bangladesh)的顺利攻势必须停下，因为巴基斯坦(Pakistan)进攻了旁遮普(Punjab)，以免孟加拉国傀儡政权的叛乱崩溃。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Pakistan has decided to neglect the peace agreements after the 1971 war who lead to the creation of Bengladesh in order to reunite the country.
译文）184 条: 巴基斯坦(Pakistan)已决定无视 1971 年战后促成孟加拉国(Bangladesh)诞生的和平协议，一心要「重新统一」国家。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Pakistan intervened by force in Bangladesh taking pretext of economical difficulties and existence of pro-Pakistani groups willing to overthrow the Bengladesh regime in order to reunite the country.
译文）184 条: 巴基斯坦(Pakistan)以经济困难、以及存在亲巴势力愿推翻孟加拉国(Bangladesh)政权为由，武力介入孟加拉国，意图重新统一国家。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Pakistan took pretext of economical difficulties and existence of pro-Pakistani groups willing to overthrow the Bangladesh regime...
译文）184 条: 巴基斯坦(Pakistan)以经济困难和存在亲巴势力为由——那些人想推翻孟加拉国(Bangladesh)政权……

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Sensing an opportunity, Vietnam tries to conquer South-East Asia.
译文）184 条: 越南(Vietnam)嗅到机会，试图征服东南亚(South-East Asia)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Taking advantage of WW3 in Europe and absence of possible intervention of USA and Russia, China invades Vietnam in order control its non accomodating neighbour.
译文）184 条: 趁欧洲(Europe)爆发第三次世界大战(WW3)、美俄都无力干预之机，中国(China)入侵越南(Vietnam)，以控制这个不听话的邻国。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Thailand intervened by fear we cross its borders definitely.
译文）184 条: 泰国(Thailand)介入，是怕我们真的一举越过它的边界。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The 155 Mk 3 picked up a leader on the first or second turn resulting in multiple fire support and devastating fire.  This will be a good unit to have.
译文）184 条: 155 Mk 3 在第一或第二回合得了一名指挥官，于是同时拥有多次火力支援和毁灭性火力。这将是个很值得拥有的单位。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The French and German Tigre/Tiger helicopters showed themselves to be much less capable than their American counterparts.
译文）184 条: 法国和德国的虎式(Tigre/Tiger)直升机，表现远不如美国的同类机型。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Leopard 2A5 and the Challenger 3s dominated the battlefield.
译文）184 条: 豹2A5(Leopard 2A5)和挑战者3(Challenger 3)主宰了战场。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Myanmar regime keeps on protesting at the UN assembly about the violation of its territory and it is indeed wiser to leave if we do not want to wage a war against India.
译文）184 条: 缅甸(Myanmar)政权不停在联合国(UN)大会上抗议其领土被侵犯；如果我们不想同印度(India)开战，撤走确实是更明智的选择。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Pakistani ambassador left a note by which his country considers the conditions which led to the creation of Bangladesh in 1971 are not existing anymore but considers our peace agreement is still valid provided India does not intervene.
译文）184 条: 巴基斯坦(Pakistan)大使留下一份照会：巴方认为 1971 年促成孟加拉国(Bangladesh)诞生的那些前提已不复存在，但只要我们不让印度(India)介入，仍承认和平协议有效。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The People’s Republic of China has sued for peace, offering substantial concessions in order to avoid the embarrassment of an invasion of China, including complete independence for Taiwan and a demilitarized region in Manciuria. Celebrations erupted around the world as newscasts of the surrendering Chinese army spread. It seems your next tour will be the parade of a hero who liberated a continent.
译文）184 条: 中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)已请求议和，为免遭入侵之辱，开出了重大让步：包括台湾(Taiwan)完全独立，以及在满洲(Manchuria)划设非军事区。中国军队投降的消息一经播出，世界各地一片欢腾。看来你的下一站行程，将是一位解放了整个大陆的英雄的阅兵式。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The People’s Republic of China has sued for peace, offering substantial concessions in order to avoid the embarrassment of an invasion of China, including complete independence for Taiwan. Celebrations erupted the world over as newscasts of the surrendering Chinese army spread. It seems your next tour will be the parade of a hero who liberated a continent.
译文）184 条: 中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)已请求议和，为免遭入侵之辱，开出了重大让步：包括台湾(Taiwan)完全独立。中国军队投降的消息一经播出，世界各地一片欢腾。看来你的下一站行程，将是一位解放了整个大陆的英雄的阅兵式。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The People’s Republic of China's invasion of South Korea under the thin guise of liberating the peninsula demands that we take swift and decisive action. Your objectives are simple: crush the North Koreans and their Chinese allies.
译文）184 条: 中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)以「解放半岛」为薄薄借口入侵韩国(South Korea)，这要求我们必须迅速、果断地行动。你的目标很简单：击垮朝鲜(North Korea)人及其中国盟友。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Russian President is outraged at your dismal performance, stating that only misguided arrogance would demand entrusting the liberation of his country to a foreign commander. The Security Council can hardly argue after the loss of men and equipment you suffered, and they have approved General Yuri Yakovlev as your replacement for the remainder of the operations in the Russian Far East. The transfer of command is effective immediately.
译文）184 条: 俄罗斯(Russia)总统对你的糟糕表现大为震怒，称只有被误导的傲慢，才会把解放他国家的重任交到一个外国指挥官手里。在你损失了那么多人马装备之后，安全理事会(Security Council)也无话可说，已批准由尤里·雅科夫列夫将军(Yuri Yakovlev)接替你在俄罗斯远东(Russian Far East)的后续作战。指挥权即刻移交。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Russian government has sued for peace and opposes us no longer.
译文）184 条: 俄罗斯(Russia)政府已请求议和，不再是我们的敌人。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The U.N. did not invest its resources expecting you to fail. You will be relieved of command before you cause irreparable damage to the Coalition, though it may already be too late.
译文）184 条: 联合国(UN)投入资源，可不是为了看你失败。在你给联军(Coalition)造成无法挽回的损失之前，你将被解除指挥权——尽管可能已经太迟了。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Vietnamese Army has been kicked out of Laos. This is the opportunity to liberate the country...
译文）184 条: 越南(Vietnam)军队已被逐出老挝(Laos)。这就是解放这个国家的机会……

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The advance thus far has been devastating, with three-quarters proceeding up the left flank and the Australian contingent of auxiliaries and a few of my troops heading up the right flank.
译文）184 条: 到目前为止进展势如破竹：四分之三的兵力沿左翼推进，澳大利亚(Australia)的辅助部队和我的一部分兵力则沿右翼前进。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The artillery did a good job.  I could have used another AVLB.  The tanks did okay, but had very few overrun attacks.  The Mirage 6000 shot up a few helos and a unit of tanks at long ranges.  But the star of the show was the battalion of Eurosams that weakened every air attack thrown at my ground units and killed a helo.
译文）184 条: 炮兵干得不错。我本可以再多一辆 AVLB 架桥车。坦克表现尚可，但几乎没有发动过几次碾压攻击。幻影6000(Mirage 6000)在远距离打掉了几架直升机和一支坦克部队。但全场的明星，是那个欧罗萨姆(Eurosam)营——它削弱了投向我的地面部队的每一次空袭，还干掉了一架直升机。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The attack of our homeland goes beyond the non respect of a peace treaty, we have called for the support of the United Nations.
译文）184 条: 对我们本土的进攻，已不只是无视一纸和约那么简单，我们已请求联合国(United Nations)支援。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The complete loss you suffered in Thailand has forced us to abandon all plans for a ground offensive in Indochina. You gave China the opportunity to tighten its grip on Southeast Asia, and robbed us of the ability to mount any serious challenge. Your service as a commander is no longer required.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The government of Russia asked as to help them regain their occupied european territories. As you are our most gifted general the president named you commander in chief of the allied forces on the European front.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The magnitude of your loss is immense. The People’s Republic of China has gained the upper hand in the Russian Far East. It will be some time before we can regroup for another assault. You will be serving stateside when that happens.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The peace agreements after the 1971 war led to the creation of Bengladesh are now clearly broken unilateraly. Of course our treaty with Bengladesh forces us to intervene to defend the oppressed population...

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The plotters have fled to Myanmar, with a small detachment of CORE forces your order are to help the Myanmar troops to get rid of this pleague once and for all!

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The presence of Chinese regular troops in Pakistan changes completely the situation, we can hardly continue this war alone otherwise a victory in Pakistan is impossible and worse a second invasion in India might become real and even successful!

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The presence of Chinese troops was a nasty surprise, the sitution has became suddenly more complex from a political standpoint...

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The sad note so far has been losing a 15 strenght Eurosam with a leader special on turn 2, but not after it shot 11 strength points out of a terrifically surprised WZ-9 helo.  RIP.
译文）184 条: 到目前为止最令人痛心的，是第 2 回合折损了一套 15 点兵力、带指挥官特技的欧罗萨姆(Eurosam)——不过它在此之前，从一架猝不及防的 WZ-9 直升机身上打掉了 11 点兵力。安息吧。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The vacations are over, commander. Our spies in Hainoi have sent us information about an imminent enemy offensive of considerable size. It will be against our positions near Cu-Chi. Deploy your units quickly and take defensive positions first before our counterattacking.
译文）184 条: 假期结束了，指挥官。我们在河内(Hainoi)的间谍传回情报：敌人即将发动一场规模可观的攻势，目标是我们在古芝(Cu-Chi)附近的阵地。迅速部署部队，先取防御态势，然后再反击。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Those deviationists, impure communists are not defeated!

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Turn 4 saw my best Tigre Helo unit ambushed by a DK-9.  Tempation to reload again.  The 13 points were whittled down to 2. My German Eurofighter Typhoons were taking horrific losses and sometimes going home at only 10% of their original strength.  So I said my last rites for the Tigre and hit the end turn button.  The Tigre was somehow magically spared.  So I retreated him south and parked him next to my RAH-66 which is down to 1 point of strength.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Turn 7 saw my Challenger III deliver the coup de grace.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Two other triggers provided more air missions, and yet another trigger increased the experience level on my Leopards.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Upgraded the 155 Mk 3 to a GCT, for better firepower and better protection.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Well, it really didn't.  The Chinese units appear to be able to stand relatively well on their own.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: What have you done, General? Our finest troops lie dead in front of the Chinese fortifications. The war will go on, but your duty will to oversee the recruitment of officers for the National Guard.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: With the American Declaration of War, China puts into effect Plan Red.  Plan Red calls for the neutralization of Russia then the conquest of Southeast Asia.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: You've been called back to Washington, Commander.  Good luck and godspeed...
译文）184 条: 你被召回了华盛顿(Washington)，指挥官。祝你好运，一路顺风……

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your defeat at Don is a disaster of unthinkable magnitude, matched only by the mistake of entrusting you with command. Our positions throughout Russia are now threatened with collapse as their idolatrous cries for the defense of ‘Mother Russia’ have inspired fanatic attacks against our forces in the Urals. Many have been successful. You are forthwith relieved of duty.
译文）184 条: 你在顿河(Don)的失利是一场难以想象的灾难，唯一能与之相比的，就是当初把指挥权交给你的那个错误。我们在俄罗斯(Russia)各地的阵地如今都面临崩溃——他们狂热地呼喊「保卫俄罗斯母亲(Mother Russia)」，煽动起对乌拉尔(Urals)我军部队的疯狂攻击，而且屡屡得手。你即刻被解除职务。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your defeat in our bid to liberate the Malay Peninsula is an absolute catastrophe. The media is all over this fiasco with dire predictions of the losses in both men and equipment that a protracted war in Southeast Asia is bound to cost. Faced with intensely negative public opinion, the President thinks it prudent to cut our losses before they become unconscionable. His first order is to remove you from command.
译文）184 条: 在我们解放马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)的行动中，你的失败是一场彻底的灾难。媒体对这场惨败穷追不舍，纷纷预测东南亚(Southeast Asia)的持久战必将付出的兵员与装备代价。面对极其负面的舆论，总统认为趁损失还没到无法接受的地步就收手是明智之举。他的第一道命令，就是解除你的指挥权。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your success in Southeast Asia was a spectacular feat, more so since the Russian offensive was an absolute failure. Their government has demanded that you personally lead the liberation of the Soviet Far East. Apparently, your name has obtained legendary status among the Russian people. The Joint Chiefs agree. Maintaining pressure on Chinese forces in Siberia is essential as our navy looks for an opening on the Chinese coast.
译文）184 条: 你在东南亚(Southeast Asia)的成功是一桩惊人的壮举，尤其因为俄国方向的攻势彻底失败了。他们的政府要求由你亲自领导解放苏联远东(Soviet Far East)。显然，你的名字在俄罗斯(Russia)民众中已近乎传奇。参谋长联席会议(Joint Chiefs)也同意了。在我海军寻找中国沿海突破口之际，持续压制西伯利亚(Siberia)的中国军队至关重要。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your utterly loss in invading Formosa, allowed their allies time to reinforce the island. A new general will be in charge of things here. You still have a chance to redeem yourself against our old foes from the North. You are dismissed.
译文）184 条: 你入侵台湾(Formosa)的彻底失败，给了他们的盟友增援该岛的时间。这里的事将由一位新将军接手。你还有机会在与北方老对手的较量中挽回自己。你被免职了。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your victory over the China was complete and the Prime Minister was impressed with the resourcefulness you displayed under such difficult circumstances. The world is now amazed by our display of unmatched power in the region
译文）184 条: 你对中国的胜利是彻底的，总理对你在如此艰难的处境下展现出的智谋印象深刻。如今，我们在这片地区展现出的无可匹敌的力量，令世界为之惊叹。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: A commander’s greatest achievements are measured in the respect he earns for the nation’s people, and your victory at Hai Phong is one that restores the honor of our ancestors who failed where you have now succeeded. With firmly established positions in northern Vietnam and the acquisition of a vital port for supply, the Chinese High Command can advance its plans for the annexation of Southeast Asia with confidence.
译文）184 条: 一位统帅最大的成就在于他为国民赢得的敬重，而你在海防(Hai Phong)的这场胜利，正为先辈挽回了颜面——当年他们折戟之处，如今由你取得了成功。凭借在越南北部稳固的阵地和一座至关重要的补给港口，中国最高统帅部得以满怀信心地推进其兼并东南亚(Southeast Asia)的计划。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: A considerable enemy force has assembled at Ulan Ude and is fortifying itself along the approaches to the city. Fortunately, control of the Trans-Siberian Railroad has allowed us to move rapidly into position for an assault on Ulan Ude. You must move quickly before the rebels and their Chinese allies can regroup.
译文）184 条: 敌军已在乌兰乌德(Ulan Ude)集结了相当大的兵力，并沿城市外围构筑工事据守。所幸控制着西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)，我们得以迅速机动到位，准备强攻乌兰乌德。你必须在叛军及其中国盟友重新集结之前迅速行动。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: A defeat like the one you suffered at Ulan Ude has dashed our hopes for a swift end to the conflict. With the onset of winter soon near, we will not be able to continue until next year. Your services are no longer needed. Return to headquarters immediately.
译文）184 条: 像你在乌兰乌德(Ulan Ude)这样的失利，已断送了我们速战速决的希望。冬季将至，我们只能等到明年再继续。不再需要你了。立即返回总部。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: A diversion attack took place at Imphal, still to prevent us to restore order in Bangladesh.
译文）184 条: 英帕尔(Imphal)方向发生了一次牵制性进攻，仍是为了阻止我们恢复孟加拉国(Bangladesh)的秩序。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: A major defeat like the one you suffered at Ulan Ude is the sort of setback which can reverse the tide of war. With your foolhardy maneuvers, you dashed our troops’ hopes for a swift end to the war just when morale was at its highest. Too many soldiers have sacrificed their lives to drive the Chinese army to its knees for you to let them back up. The Joints Chiefs of Staff cannot afford to risk another such defeat and have released you from further duties.
译文）184 条: 像你在乌兰乌德(Ulan Ude)这样的重大失利，足以逆转战局。你那莽撞的用兵，恰在士气最高涨之际断送了我军速胜的希望。为了让中国军队跪地求饶，已有太多士兵牺牲，岂容你让他们重新站起来。参谋长联席会议(Joints Chiefs of Staff)不能再冒一次这样的风险，已解除你的后续职务。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: A warrior’s greatest weapon is the fear he instills in his foes. Caught between the threat of an attack on Moscow and our assembly of troops along the Caspian Sea, the Russians have sent large forces in both directions. This has only accomplished the disruption of their defenses. The time is now to begin the second phase of our operation with an assault on Astrakhan. This will secure our positions in Kazakhstan and open the way for the advance on Volgograd. Drive west through Chertonbay and Kalinino to capture Astrakhan and secure a way over the Volga River.
译文）184 条: 战士最厉害的武器，是他在敌人心中种下的恐惧。夹在进攻莫斯科(Moscow)的威胁与我军沿里海(Caspian Sea)集结之间，俄军被迫向两个方向分兵——结果只是把自己的防线搅乱。现在正是发起第二阶段行动、强攻阿斯特拉罕(Astrakhan)的时候。这将巩固我们在哈萨克斯坦(Kazakhstan)的阵地，并为进军伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)打开通路。向西经切尔通贝(Chertonbay)和卡利尼诺(Kalinino)推进，攻占阿斯特拉罕，并夺取一处渡过伏尔加河(Volga)的通道。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: After a long campaign the smokestacks of Volgograd are within sight. The Russian propaganda machine has brought up visions of past glories by declaring the battle for this city the turning point. The Americans and their allies have promised continued support for the failing Russian regime. This is your greatest challenge to date as a multi-national force stands in the way of Chinese destiny. You must seize Volgograd, destroy the UN forces there, and break the Russian will to resist.
译文）184 条: 经过一场漫长的战役，伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)的烟囱已经遥遥在望。俄罗斯的宣传机器把这场夺城之战说成转折点，想让人们重温昔日的荣光。美国(America)及其盟国已经承诺继续支援这个摇摇欲坠的俄罗斯政权。这是你迄今为止最大的挑战——一支多国部队正挡在中国命运的路上。你必须拿下伏尔加格勒，歼灭那里的联合国(UN)部队，打垮俄罗斯的抵抗意志。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: After a successful invasion of South Korea, the North Korean attack bogged down around Seoul. The Americans responded by landing at Inchon, hopefully to drive back the North Koreans before the Chinese intervene.
译文）184 条: 成功入侵韩国(South Korea)后，朝鲜(North Korea)的攻势在首尔(Seoul)一带陷入僵局。美国(America)以仁川(Inchon)登陆作为回应，希望在中国插手之前把朝鲜军打回去。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: After crossing the Ho Chi Minh trail you must deploy your troops to the north of Khe Sanh.  Clear the hills of any enemy troops and then undertake the attack on the enemy base. Reinforcements from the North with heliport capabilities will arrive to help in the struggle against the enemy positions located in the hills.
译文）184 条: 越过胡志明小道(Ho Chi Minh trail)之后，你必须把部队部署到溪山(Khe Sanh)以北。肃清山间的敌军，然后对敌军基地发起攻击。具备机降能力的北方增援部队将会赶到，协助你们对付山中的敌军阵地。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: After losing Irkutsk, the Russians enlisted the aid of their former state, Kazakhstan, and diverted large numbers of troops and equipment to a staging area near Almaty. This is a desperate attempt to forestall our advance by launching an invasion into China itself. You must crush the Russian build-up as well as capture Almaty and the surrounding towns.
译文）184 条: 丢掉伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)之后，俄罗斯(Russia)请来了昔日同袍哈萨克斯坦(Kazakhstan)相助，把大量兵力装备调往阿拉木图(Almaty)附近的一处集结地。这是他们为延缓我军推进、不惜入侵中国本土的孤注一掷。你既要粉碎俄军的集结，也要攻占阿拉木图及周边城镇。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: After the People's Republic of China invasion captured Hai Phong, the Vietnamese army launches a counterattack to destroy the Chinese army before it can move on Hanoi.
译文）184 条: 中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)入侵并攻占海防(Hai Phong)后，越南军队发起反击，力图在中国军队向河内(Hanoi)推进之前将其歼灭。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: After the surprise invasion across Lake Baikal, you must press this advantage and seize the city of Irkutsk.
译文）184 条: 在越过贝加尔湖(Lake Baikal)的突袭之后，你必须扩大战果，夺取伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: After the war against Russia, China has established a defensive area around Volgograd.
译文）184 条: 对俄战争之后，中国在伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)周边建立了一片防御区。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: After your victory in Korea we are sending your army to Russia. With the help of our European allies we are planning a push towards Volgograd. However China is anticipating our trust and they are building a large array of fortifications West of the city. Your first mission is to penetrate this layer of fortifications south of the Don river and make possible an attack against Volgograd.
译文）184 条: 你在朝鲜(Korea)取胜后，我们把你的部队调往俄罗斯(Russia)。在欧洲(European)盟友协助下，我们计划向伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)推进。但中国已预料到这一点，正在该城以西修筑大片工事。你的首个任务是突破顿河(Don)以南的这层工事，为进攻伏尔加格勒创造条件。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Although the South Koreans desire nothing more than a reunified peninsula, the threat of U.S. forces exerting direct control over them is all that keeps them fighting. In order to alleviate their fears of the U.S. landing an occupation force, it is imperative that you continue the push toward the port of Pusan. Liberate the city of Taejon as swiftly as possible, and sweep away any resistance remaining along the western coast of the peninsula.
译文）184 条: 尽管韩国人最盼望的就是半岛统一，但正是对美军直接控制他们的担忧，才让他们继续作战。为打消他们对美军占领部队登陆的恐惧，你必须继续向釜山(Pusan)港推进。尽快解放大田(Taejon)，并扫清半岛西岸的残余抵抗。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: An assault on Ekaterinburg, the gateway to the Urals, will begin the offensive. You must capture this key city and nearby Uralmash, and then establish supply points along the towns on the Trans-Siberian Railroad.
译文）184 条: 进攻叶卡捷琳堡(Ekaterinburg)——乌拉尔(Urals)的门户——将拉开攻势序幕。你必须夺取这座重镇和附近的乌拉尔机械厂(Uralmash)，然后沿西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)上的城镇设立补给点。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: As a reward for your past victories Bejing wants to give you the opportunity to become the liberator of Ho Chi Minh. The goal of central command is to make a fast advance on Saigon and continue to surprise the world with our lightning victories over the enemy.  Maybe we can even trap the supporting countries like Japan on the roof of their embassy.
译文）184 条: 为奖赏你过去的战功，北京(Bejing)愿意给你一个成为解放胡志明市(Ho Chi Minh)之人的机会。统帅部的目标，是快速向西贡(Saigon)推进，继续以闪电般的胜利让世界惊叹。也许我们还能把日本(Japan)这类支持国的人堵在他们使馆的楼顶上。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: As the capital of South Korea, Seoul is not only a vital military objective, its value as a political asset is immeasurable. The North Koreans occupy what is the most heavily fortified region in the world, while the Chinese have amassed a substantial defensive force in Seoul. You must recapture Seoul and drive the enemy out of the area’s fortifications.
译文）184 条: 作为韩国(South Korea)的首都，首尔(Seoul)不仅是至关重要的军事目标，其政治价值更是无可估量。朝鲜(North Korea)占据着世界上工事最密集的地区，而中国已在首尔集结了可观的防御兵力。你必须夺回首尔，把敌人逐出这一带的工事。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: As the capitol of South Korea, Seoul is not only a vital military objective, but also its strategic value as a political asset is immeasurable. You must recapture Seoul and drive the enemy back to gain control of the area’s fortifications.
译文）184 条: 作为韩国(South Korea)的首都，首尔(Seoul)不仅是至关重要的军事目标，其作为政治资产的战略价值同样无可估量。你必须夺回首尔，击退敌人，夺取这一带工事的控制权。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: As the capitol of South Korea, Seoul is not only a vital military objective, its value as a political asset is immeasurable. The North Koreans and their Chinese allies have amassed a substantial offensive force just north of Seoul.  I'm afraid that war is very imminent. You must hold Seoul at all costs if at all possible...  Good luck commander.  You'll need it.
译文）184 条: 作为韩国(South Korea)的首都，首尔(Seoul)不仅是至关重要的军事目标，其政治价值更是无可估量。朝鲜(North Korea)及其中国盟友已在首尔以北集结了可观的进攻兵力。恐怕战事一触即发。你必须不惜一切代价、尽一切可能守住首尔……祝你好运，指挥官。你会需要的。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: As the capitol of South Korea, Seoul is not only a vital military objective, its value as a political asset is immeasurable. The North Koreans occupy what is the most heavily fortified region in the world, while the Chinese have amassed a substantial defensive force in Seoul. You must recapture Seoul and drive the enemy out of the area’s fortifications.
译文）184 条: 作为韩国(South Korea)的首都，首尔(Seoul)不仅是至关重要的军事目标，其政治价值更是无可估量。朝鲜(North Korea)占据着世界上工事最密集的地区，而中国已在首尔集结了可观的防御兵力。你必须夺回首尔，把敌人逐出这一带的工事。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: As the first step we need to break through this line of fortifications and open the way to Volgograd. China is moving forces West to reinforce this line. You must achieve a breakthrough before they reach the front line.
译文）184 条: 第一步，我们要突破这道工事线，为进军伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)打开通路。中国正调兵西援这条防线。你必须在他们抵达前线之前达成突破。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: As the primary hub of transport through the Urals and into the depths of Siberia, Kazan is the critical link in all operations against western Russia. You must move quickly to take Kazan and points west.
译文）184 条: 作为穿越乌拉尔(Urals)深入西伯利亚(Siberia)腹地的交通枢纽，喀山(Kazan)是对俄西部一切作战的关键节点。你必须迅速行动，拿下喀山及其以西要点。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: As the primary means of transport between European and Asian Russia, the Trans-Siberian Railroad is the critical link in all of our operations against the People’s Republic of China. The Chinese are mobilizing additional forces to protect their hold on it. You must move quickly to take Kazan before they cross the Urals. From there, you must capture supply points south along the Trans-Siberian Railroad and secure the waterways down the length of the Volga.
译文）184 条: 作为连接欧俄与亚洲俄罗斯的主要通道，西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)是我们一切对华作战的关键节点。中国正调集更多兵力保护其对铁路的控制。你必须在他们越过乌拉尔(Urals)之前迅速拿下喀山(Kazan)。随后，你必须夺取西伯利亚大铁路沿线的南方补给点，并控制伏尔加河(Volga)全段的水道。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: As the primary means of transport through the Urals and into the depths of Russia, the Trans-Siberian Railroad is the critical link in all of our operations against the People’s Republic of China. The Chinese are no fools and are mobilizing additional forces to protect their hold on it. You must move quickly to take Kazan before the Chines cross the Urals. From there, you must capture supply points south along the Trans-Siberian Railroad and secure the waterways down the length of the Volga.
译文）184 条: 作为穿越乌拉尔(Urals)深入俄罗斯腹地的主要通道，西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)是我们一切对华作战的关键节点。中国人并非蠢人，正调集更多兵力保护其对铁路的控制。你必须在他们越过乌拉尔之前迅速拿下喀山(Kazan)。随后，你必须夺取西伯利亚大铁路沿线的南方补给点，并控制伏尔加河(Volga)全段的水道。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: As the primary means of transport through the Urals and into the depths of Russia, the Trans-Siberian Railroad is the critical link in all operations in Siberia. The Chinese have captured Kazan, and you must retake Kazan.
译文）184 条: 作为穿越乌拉尔(Urals)深入俄罗斯腹地的主要通道，西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)是一切西伯利亚(Siberia)作战的关键节点。中国已夺取喀山(Kazan)，你必须把它夺回来。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: As you know, commander, our positions near Tuy Hoa are right next to the South Korean troops who are now supporting Hainoi.
译文）184 条: 如你所知，指挥官，我们在绥和(Tuy Hoa)附近的阵地，紧挨着目前支持河内(Hainoi)的韩国部队。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: At Stalingrad, the Russians fought alone while the world watched and hoped for the best.  Now, we are in a great position to help our valiant Russian allies to drive the Chinese out.  The Chinese are weak in Volgograd, but be vigilant.  They are never to be taken lightly.
译文）184 条: 在斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)，当年俄国人孤军奋战，全世界都在旁观并期盼最好的结果。如今，我们处在大好位置，可以协助英勇的俄罗斯(Russia)盟友把中国人赶出去。中国军队在伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)兵力薄弱，但要保持警惕——他们从不容轻视。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Attack of the Plei Me Camp - March 19th, 2015
译文）184 条: 波来美营地之战 - 2015 年 3 月 19 日

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Attack on Khe Sanh - August 15th, 2015
译文）184 条: 溪山攻防战 - 2015 年 8 月 15 日

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Command of a multi-national force is not to be taken lightly. When lives are lost with no show for it then even the smallest mistakes are magnified well beyond the scope of a strategic disaster. Your handling of the assault on Volgograd has the Russians demanding your head on a platter. It appears Their wishes will be granted.
译文）184 条: 统率一支多国部队绝非儿戏。当生命白白牺牲、却毫无战果时，哪怕最微小的失误，也会被放大到远超一场战略灾难的程度。你对伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)进攻的处置，已让俄罗斯人要求把你的脑袋端上盘子。看来他们的愿望就要实现了。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Commander welcome again to the front. The war with the Hanoi is about to end. As you know, our latest offensives have all ended with an overwhelming victory. The northern part of South Vietnam has been cleared of enemies by the People's Army of China. Hue and Da Nang along other key cities have been also liberated and now it is time for the heart of South Vietnam: Saigon! We need to end this war as soon as possible to prevent any major intervention of USA now that the war in Europe is not going well for Russia.
译文）184 条: 指挥官，欢迎再次回到前线。与河内(Hanoi)的战争即将结束。如你所知，我们最近几次攻势都以压倒性胜利告终。越南(South Vietnam)北部已被中国人民军肃清。顺化(Hue)和岘港(Da Nang)等重镇也已解放，现在轮到南越的心脏——西贡(Saigon)了！我们必须尽快结束这场战争，以防美国(America)大规模插手——如今欧洲(Europe)战事对俄罗斯(Russia)不利。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Comrade commander, we again need your men. As you know, our mid year operations in the province of Kontum have gone well, nevertheless there are still several enemy forward bases that we must destroy. Those bases are too close to our supply routes for Ho the Chi Minh trail and our area 609.  For this reason they must be destroyed. In addition in the province of Kontum an enemy offensive is anticipated and our enemies do not have to count on those outposts.
译文）184 条: 指挥官同志，我们又需要你的部队了。如你所知，我们在昆嵩(Kontum)省的年中作战进展顺利，但仍有多处敌军前沿基地必须拔除。那些基地离我们胡志明小道(Ho Chi Minh trail)和 609 区的补给线太近，因此必须摧毁。此外，昆嵩省料将遭遇敌军攻势，绝不能让敌人依靠这些据点。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Coveting it as the cornerstone to their domination of the Asian sphere, the Chinese are pouring everything they have into the defense of Indochina. Our navies have managed to thwart enemy operations in the South China Sea, but victory for our forces on land requires a firm foundation to operate from. You are to establish defensive positions east of the Nang Rang River, then assault Bangkok and secure the rail lines north along the Chayo Praya River to Saraburi.
译文）184 条: 中国把中南半岛(Indochina)视为其主导亚洲的根本，正倾其所有加强防御。我海军已成功挫败敌人在南海(South China Sea)的行动，但我军要在陆上取胜，就必须有稳固的基地。你要在南让河(Nang Rang River)以东建立防御阵地，随后进攻曼谷(Bangkok)，并控制昭披耶河(Chayo Praya River)北上至沙拉武里(Saraburi)的铁路。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Ekaterinburg stands as the gateway through the Urals where the Chinese continue to strip Russia of its precious resources. Your victory at Astrakhan has paid off as the Russians were able to field a force from Volgograd in time to join our assault through the mountain pass. # PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: From our secure foothold in Bangkok, our forces were able to land without incident and have managed to push the already decimated Chinese back into Laos and Vietnam.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Good morning comrade commander. As you know, our campaign of attacking enemy forward bases continues.  Khe Sanh is the provincial capital and the key towards controlling our national Route 9. Your mission is to coordinate the attack against the Vietnamese base at Khe Sanh. That base is a constant threat against our supply routes through Laos.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Good work comrade. The south Koreans have been defeated and they are not going to be a problem. Anyway it seem they have assumed a defensive role at this time and Tuy Hoa is still well protected.
译文）184 条: 干得好，同志。韩国人已被击败，不再是问题。总之，他们目前似乎已转取守势，而绥和(Tuy Hoa)依然防守严密。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: I had planned a small banquet and a speech in your honor.  I had written down, "The People’s Republic of China got a true taste of modern warfare along the Volga. Your timely recapture of Volgograd and its industries has given the Russian nation and its teetering government a much needed boost."
译文）184 条: 我原打算为你办一场小型宴会并致词。我已经写好了：「中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)在伏尔加河(Volga)畔真正尝到了现代战争的滋味。你及时夺回伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)及其工业，为俄罗斯民族和它摇摇欲坠的政府注入了一剂急需的强心针。」

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: If ever the U.S. needed a slam-dunk, it was at Ho Chi Minh City, and you delivered it. China has relinquished control of the Spratly Islands, giving our allies access to the oil resources there and leaving the field wide open for our naval forces to dominate in the South China Sea.
译文）184 条: 如果说美国(America)什么时候需要一场压倒性的胜利，那就是在胡志明市(Ho Chi Minh City)——而你交出了答卷。中国已放弃对南沙群岛(Spratly Islands)的控制，让我方盟友得以获取那里的石油资源，也为我海军主宰南海(South China Sea)敞开了大门。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: In order to secure our conquests in Siberia, you must secure all of the Russian Far East up to Ekaterinburg as a bulwark against future attacks by our enemies.
译文）184 条: 为巩固我们在西伯利亚(Siberia)的战果，你必须拿下直至叶卡捷琳堡(Ekaterinburg)的整个俄罗斯远东(Russian Far East)，作为抵御敌人未来进攻的屏障。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Intelligence has confirmed that an American force has been sent to help the battered Russians. Despite the presence of the Americans in the vicinity of Irkutsk, you must immediately establish the bridgehead across Lake Baikal, and then seize the city of Irkutsk. This is your opportunity to show the world the power of the Chinese War Machine.
译文）184 条: 情报已证实，一支美军部队被派来援助备受打击的俄军。尽管美国人在伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)附近出现，你仍须立即在贝加尔湖(Lake Baikal)对岸建立桥头堡，随后夺取伊尔库茨克。这是你向世界展示中国战争机器威力的机会。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: It had been hoped that you would not repeat the defeats of our ancestors at Hai Phong, but your fear of an ancient foe has mastered you. The Premier has ordered your immediate dismissal for the embarrassment that your loss burdens the People’s Republic of China with.
译文）184 条: 本以为你不会重蹈先辈在海防(Hai Phong)的覆辙，可你对宿敌的畏惧却占了上风。总理已下令将你立即免职，以消解你这场失利给中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)带来的难堪。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: It has been three long months since our declaration of war. In that time we have seen many disasters including Seoul and Taejon. Now you must defend Pusan, much like the Marines did a few decades ago.  If you can save Pusan, then we may be able to land reinforcements from Japan.
译文）184 条: 自我们宣战以来，已过去漫长的三个月。其间我们遭遇了诸多灾难，包括首尔(Seoul)和大田(Taejon)。现在你必须守住釜山(Pusan)，就像几十年前海军陆战队那样。如果你能救下釜山，我们或许还能从日本(Japan)运来增援。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: It has been three long years since our declaration of war. In that time we have seen many disasters, Irkutsk, Volgograd, and Southeast Asia. Now, after a fierce battle down the Korean Peninsula, we have finally stopped the Chinese and their North Korean allies outside the Korean city of Pusan. You have been selected to strike the blow that will liberate Asia from the Chinese Red Banner.
译文）184 条: 自我们宣战以来，已过去漫长的三年。其间我们遭遇了诸多灾难——伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)、伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)、东南亚(Southeast Asia)。如今，经过朝鲜半岛(Korean Peninsula)的激战，我们终于在釜山(Pusan)城外汇合中国军队及其朝鲜(North Korea)盟友并将其挡住。你被选中来打出这一击——把亚洲从中国的红旗(Chinese Red Banner)下解放出来。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: It is crucial that you capture Taejon and the roads north to Choch’iwan quickly, as well as securing the western coast of the peninsula north to Hongsong.
译文）184 条: 你必须迅速夺取大田(Taejon)及北上鸟致院(Choch'iwan)的公路，并控制半岛西岸北上至洪城(Hongsong)的地区。这一点至关重要。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: It is time to settle scores with our age-old enemies, the Vietnamese as well as the transformed puppet states of the West, Thailand and Malaysia. For far too long we have watched as this area break away from tradition and transform into the ways of the decadent West. Your first objective is to seize the Vietnamese capital of Hanoi and capture the port of Hai Phong. Be prepared for bitter resistance, as the Vietnamese are well known for their tenacious defense.
译文）184 条: 现在是跟我们世仇清算的时候了——越南(Vietnam)，还有西方那两个变了味的傀儡国泰国(Thailand)和马来西亚(Malaysia)。太久以来，我们眼睁睁看着这一地区脱离传统、蜕变成腐朽西方的模样。你的首个目标是夺取越南首都河内(Hanoi)并拿下海防(Hai Phong)港。做好遭遇顽抗的准备，越南人以死守著称。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Judging by the thrashing you took at Astrakhan, it is difficult to believe you were in command of the finest military force in the world. Those men deserved better. Your replacement has already been dispatched. Perhaps babysitting the white-coats at McMurdo Station will prove more in line with your abilities. Start packing immediately.
译文）184 条: 从你在阿斯特拉罕(Astrakhan)挨的那顿狠揍看，很难相信你曾指挥着世界上最好的军队。那些人本该得到更好的。接替你的人已经派出。也许去麦克默多站(McMurdo Station)照看那些科研人员，才更合你的本事。立刻收拾行李。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Khabarovsk is an ideal place to unleash the offensive against the Russian regime. By taking this vital city and cutting all communications along the Trans-Siberian Railroad we can isolate the Russian Far East. You must quickly seize Khabarovsk. This will set up our forces to take Sakhalin island and then the port of Vladivostok from its undefended northern front. Speed is the key to your success.
译文）184 条: 哈巴罗夫斯克(Khabarovsk)是向俄罗斯政权发动攻势的理想地点。夺下这座重镇，切断西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)沿线的一切交通，就能把俄罗斯远东(Russian Far East)孤立起来。你必须火速攻占哈巴罗夫斯克。这一步将为我军拿下萨哈林岛(Sakhalin)、再从防御薄弱的北面直取符拉迪沃斯托克港(Vladivostok)铺平道路。速度，是你取胜的关键。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Led by a revamped American military machine that has stopped the Chinese drive at Pusan, the United Nations attempt to halt the People's Republic of China in South Korea, then continue the liberation of all Chinese held foreign territories.
译文）184 条: 在美国(America)重整旗鼓的军事机器的带领下——它在釜山(Pusan)挡住了中国的推进——联合国(United Nations)试图在韩国(South Korea)阻止中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)，随后继续解放所有被中国占据的外国领土。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Led by a revamped European military machine that has stopped the Chinese drive at Pusan, the United Nations led by the French, the British and the Germans attempt to halt the People's Republic of China in South Korea, then continue the liberation of all Chinese held foreign territories.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Look around you Commander.  It is hard to believe that here was fought the most significant battle of World War II.  While the name of the city has changed from Tsaritsyn to Stalingrad to Volgograd, the terrain is the same, the people are the same, and little else has changed.  Only the buildings are perhaps more modern than before.  Look at the great sculpture of Mother Russia towering over the city.  Did you know that it is the world's tallest and that it is twice as tall as our own Statue of Liberty?
译文）184 条: 环顾四周吧，指挥官。很难相信，第二次世界大战中最重要的一仗就在这里打响。这座城市的名字从察里津(Tsaritsyn)改到斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)，又改到伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)，但地形未变，人民未变，其他也几乎没变——只有建筑或许比从前更现代了。看那座高耸在城上的「俄罗斯母亲」巨型雕像。你知道吗，它是世界最高的，比我们自己的自由女神像(Statue of Liberty)还要高一倍。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Meeting stiff resistance at the Volga, the advance of People's Republic of China stalled at Kazan. Russia, with U.N. assistance, immediately launches a counterattack to recapture Kazan and secure the bridgeheads on the Volga.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: North Korea and its allies cut off the retreat of the Western forces, trapping them in Seoul. With no supply, the U.S. and South Korea make a desperate bid to smash through the Eastern defenses and gain control of Inchon in order to land reinforcements.

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Now is the time to clean up the southern flank by taking the vital port city of Astrakhan on the Caspian Sea. Intelligence believes that the Chinese forces in this area are preparing an offensive aimed at the recapture of Volgograd. You must take the city of Astrakhan and sweep all Chinese units from the area.
译文）184 条: 现在是肃清南翼、拿下里海(Caspian Sea)重镇阿斯特拉罕(Astrakhan)的时候了。情报认为，这一带的中国军队正筹备一场以夺回伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)为目标的攻势。你必须攻占阿斯特拉罕，扫清该地区所有中国部队。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Now that you have returned to the Russian front, your first mission is the liberation of Almaty. This gains us a new ally, in the people of Kazakhstan, as well as a secure southern flank for future operations. You must take the city of Almaty and secure the roads leading east to Karakamyr.
