The Security Council can hardly argue after the losses of men and equipment you have suffered, and they have approved Gen. Donat Kapitsa as your replacement for the remainder of the operations in the Russian Far East. The transfer of command is effective immediately.
译文）184 条: 俄罗斯(Russia)总统对你在哈巴罗夫斯克(Khabarovsk)的惨败大为震怒，称只有美国式的傲慢，才会把解放他国家的重任交到一个外国指挥官手里。在你损失了那么多人马装备之后，安全理事会(Security Council)也无话可说，已批准由多纳特·卡皮察将军(Donat Kapitsa)接替你在俄罗斯远东(Russian Far East)的后续作战。指挥权即刻移交。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Russian attack is once again rolling and the High Command has recalled you to the Pacific Fleet. So far we have not been able to make any headway onto the Chinese mainland. Our new Japanese allies fear long range rocket strikes from the island of Sakhalin and we have tasked you with clearing this island. Intelligence reports that there is a large Chinese army present. You are to land at Poronask under cover of our fleet and rapidly secure the entire island before the Chinese have a chance to use their rockets on the Japanese homeland.
译文）184 条: 俄国的攻势又起，最高统帅部已把你召回太平洋舰队(Pacific Fleet)。到目前为止，我们一直未能在中国的本土上取得进展。我们新的日本(Japan)盟友担心来自萨哈林岛(Sakhalin)的远程火箭袭击，我们把肃清该岛的任务交给你。情报显示岛上有大批中国军队。你要在我舰队掩护下于波罗奈斯克(Poronask)登陆，在中国人有机会用火箭袭击日本本土之前迅速控制全岛。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Russians appear incapable of halting your relentless advance despite their claims of technological superiority. This victory at Ulan Ude proves the worth of our nation’s people, and their most capable leaders.
译文）184 条: 尽管俄罗斯人自称技术优越，却似乎无法阻止你势不可挡的推进。乌兰乌德(Ulan Ude)这一胜，证明了我们民族的将士和他们最得力的指挥官的真正价值。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Russians are stumbling in their own backyard, and your relentless victories have them more concerned with finding cover than fighting back. With Kazan secure and the Trans-Siberian Railroad feeding out troops steady supplies, the People’s Republic of China is well prepared to hold its gains in the Urals.
译文）184 条: 俄罗斯人在自家后院跌跌撞撞，你接连的胜利让他们更忙于寻找掩体，而不是反击。喀山(Kazan)既已稳固，西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)又为我军源源不断送来补给，中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)已做好充分准备守住它在乌拉尔(Urals)的战果。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Russians expended great effort and resources to rebuild their forces, and your disastrous loss at Almaty has thrown it all away. It seems they would have been better served building housing for the refugees that are streaming across the Urals to escape Chinese occupation. At this point, these refugees are unlikely to ever see their homes again. It should come as no surprise that the Russian President’s request for your dismissal has been granted.
译文）184 条: 俄罗斯人花费巨大心力重建军队，而你在阿拉木图(Almaty)的惨败让这一切付诸东流。看来他们本可以把力气用来为那些翻越乌拉尔(Urals)逃避中国占领的难民盖房子。到了这一步，这些难民恐怕再也见不到自己的家了。俄罗斯总统要罢免你的请求获得批准，也不足为奇。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Russians have enlisted the aid of their former country, Kazakhstan, and diverted large numbers of troops and equipment to a staging area at Almaty. This is a desperate attempt to launch an invasion into China itself. Local resistance will be fierce, so you must crush the Russian build-up as well as capture Almaty and the surrounding towns.
译文）184 条: 俄罗斯人请来昔日同袍哈萨克斯坦(Kazakhstan)相助，把大量兵力装备调往阿拉木图(Almaty)的一处集结地。这是他们孤注一掷、不惜入侵中国本土的举动。当地抵抗会很激烈，因此你既要粉碎俄军的集结，也要攻占阿拉木图及周边城镇。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The South Koreans have long suffered the decay of traditional values under the decadent influence of the West. Our North Korean allies, faced by one of the most fortified areas in the world, the 38th parallel, have not been able to stop this decline. You are now in a position to restore order to the Korean Peninsula. You must break through the wall of forts, seize Seoul, and drive south to the strategic port city of Pusan. The West has been able to rebuild their armies and are currently deploying and mobilizing in South Korea. You must complete the conquest of the peninsula in record speed. Once more the premier calls upon your skills.
译文）184 条: 韩国(South Korea)人长期在西方腐朽影响下，眼看着传统价值一步步沦丧。我们的朝鲜(North Korea)盟友面对世界上工事最密集的地区之一——三八线(38th parallel)——始终无力遏止这种衰败。如今你有了重整朝鲜半岛(Korean Peninsula)秩序的机会。你必须突破堡垒之墙，夺取首尔(Seoul)，再向南直取战略港口釜山(Pusan)。西方已重建其军队，目前正在韩国部署调动。你必须在极短的时间内完成对半岛的征服。总理再一次寄望于你的本领。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The U.S. did not invest its defense budget toward technological superiority for you to stumble blindly into battle like some Viking berserker with a blunt sword. The use of advanced weapon systems requires a degree of tactical expertise that you have failed to display. You will be relieved of command before you cause irreparable damage to the Coalition. It may already be too late after the loss of Ekaterinburg.
译文）184 条: 美国(America)投入国防预算追求技术优势，可不是为了让你像持钝剑的维京狂战士那样盲目地冲进战场。使用先进武器系统，需要一定的战术素养，而你未能体现出来。在你给联军(Coalition)造成无法挽回的损失之前，你将被解除指挥权。叶卡捷琳堡(Ekaterinburg)失守之后，或许已经太迟了。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The U.S. mobilizes its forces to aid their Russian allies before the battered nation completely collapses. They launch an offensive to drive the People's Republic of China from the Urals with an assault on Volgograd.
译文）184 条: 美国(America)调动兵力，赶在这个备受打击的国家彻底崩溃之前支援其俄罗斯(Russia)盟友。他们发动攻势，以强攻伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)把中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)逐出乌拉尔(Urals)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The United Kingdom and U.S. press the advance up the Malay Peninsula toward George Town as the People's Republic of China attempts hold on to its recent conquests.
译文）184 条: 英国(United Kingdom)和美国(America)沿马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)向乔治市(George Town)推进，而中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)正竭力守住它新近征服的地盘。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Western forces hastily attempt to set up a last defense of the Malay Peninsula as the People's Republic of China advances on Singapore.
译文）184 条: 西方部队仓促地试图为马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)组织最后的防御，而中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)正朝新加坡(Singapore)推进。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Western offensive opens with a drive toward Volgograd to push the Chinese back to the Don River.
译文）184 条: 西方的攻势以进军伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)开局，意图把中国军队逼回顿河(Don River)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The Western-backed United Nations has lent their full support to a war in Southeast Asia.  They have invaded and captured Ho Chi Minh City. You must free Ho Chi Minh City to prevent any further Western incursions, you must also secure the coastal approaches and gain control of the entire Saigon River Delta.
译文）184 条: 西方扶植的联合国(United Nations)全力支持东南亚(Southeast Asia)的一场战争。他们已入侵并攻占胡志明市(Ho Chi Minh City)。你必须解放胡志明市，阻止西方进一步侵犯；你还必须控制沿海通道，取得整个西贡河三角洲(Saigon River Delta)的控制权。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The area has long been under territorial dispute at the confluence of the rivers near Khabarovsk, and it is imperative that the Russian border is established in no uncertain terms. You must recapture Khabarovsk and drive the Chinese forces from their positions.
译文）184 条: 哈巴罗夫斯克(Khabarovsk)附近河流交汇处长期以来存在领土争端，明确划定俄罗斯边界势在必行。你必须夺回哈巴罗夫斯克，把中国军队逐出阵地。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The capture of Almaty was the first step towards the reconquest of Siberia. The vastness of Siberian wilderness makes logistical support a critical factor in our strategy to free the Russian people and break the stranglehold that the People’s Republic of China placed upon the world. You must capture Irkutsk to secure vital supply lines along the Trans-Siberian Railroad and establish forward positions at Maloye Goloustnoye and Baykal.
译文）184 条: 攻占阿拉木图(Almaty)是重夺西伯利亚(Siberia)的第一步。西伯利亚荒野的广袤，使我军战略中的后勤支援成为关键——要解放俄罗斯人民、打破中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)对世界的扼制。你必须夺取伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)，以保障西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)沿线的关键补给线，并在小戈洛乌斯特诺耶(Maloye Goloustnoye)和贝加尔(Baykal)建立前沿阵地。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The capture of Astrakhan has stunned the Russians and exposed their lack of wisdom in attempting to oppose you. Your victory has secured a base to assemble our troops and equipment, while the Russians have no choice but to fall back.
译文）184 条: 攻占阿斯特拉罕(Astrakhan)让俄罗斯人大吃一惊，也暴露出他们妄图与你为敌的失策。你的胜利为我们赢得了一处集结兵力装备的基地，而俄军别无选择，只能后撤。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The capture of Ekaterinburg was a remarkable display of military might and tactical shrewdness. The Russian President has even requested your expertise in the rebuilding of his armies. You will not be able to accept that honor, however, since the Joint Chiefs of Staff have more rigorous duties in mind elsewhere now that all semblance of resistance was crushed out of the Chinese forces in the Urals.
译文）184 条: 夺取叶卡捷琳堡(Ekaterinburg)，是军事实力与战术机智的非凡展现。俄罗斯总统甚至请你协助重建其军队。不过你无法接受这份荣誉——如今乌拉尔(Urals)一带中国军队的抵抗已被彻底粉碎，参谋长联席会议(Joint Chiefs of Staff)在别处为你安排了更艰巨的任务。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The capture of Ekaterinburg was a remarkable display of military might and tactical shrewdness. The Russian President has even requested your expertise in the rebuilding of his armies. You will not be able to accept that honor, however, since the Secretary General has more rigorous duties in mind elsewhere now that civilization has been returned to the Urals.
译文）184 条: 夺取叶卡捷琳堡(Ekaterinburg)，是军事实力与战术机智的非凡展现。俄罗斯总统甚至请你协助重建其军队。不过你无法接受这份荣誉——如今文明已重回乌拉尔(Urals)，秘书长在别处为你安排了更艰巨的任务。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The capture of Penang and the establishment of supply routes were an outstanding demonstration of your talent and versatility. The Western-backed forces are now hastily retreating to the tip of the Malay Peninsula. The Prime Minister is well pleased with the results of your victory.
译文）184 条: 攻占槟城(Penang)并建立补给线，是你才华与多面能力的杰出展示。西方扶植的部队如今正仓皇退向马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)的南端。总理对你的胜利成果十分满意。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The capture of Penang and the establishment of supply routes were an outstanding demonstration of your wisdom and versatility. The Chinese High Command is well pleased with the results of your victory as the Western forces are now hastily retreating to the tip of the Malay Peninsula with the misguided hope of making a stand.
译文）184 条: 攻占槟城(Penang)并建立补给线，是你才智与多面能力的杰出展示。中国最高统帅部对你的胜利成果十分满意——西方部队如今正仓皇退向马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)的南端，还抱着负隅顽抗的错误指望。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The capture of Penang is critical to our efforts of strengthening our defenses against the threats from the west. You must advance across the Rai River to seize Penang, and secure the roads south in preparation for an assault on Singapore.
译文）184 条: 攻占槟城(Penang)，对我们加强西面防御、应对来自西方的威胁至关重要。你必须渡过莱河(Rai River)夺取槟城，并控制南下的公路，为进攻新加坡(Singapore)做准备。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The capture of Sakhalin Island was an outstanding achievement. Your determined action pulverized the enemy’s ability to strike back at our forces and left the People’s Republic of China defending an unsupported position at Vladivostok.
译文）184 条: 夺取萨哈林岛(Sakhalin)是一项杰出的成就。你果断的行动粉碎了敌人反击我军的能力，让中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)只能死守符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)这个失去策应的据点。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The capture of Sakhalin Island was an outstanding achievement. Your determined action pulverized the enemy’s ability to strike back at our forces and left the People’s Republic of China with no hopes of ever regaining Vladivostok.
译文）184 条: 夺取萨哈林岛(Sakhalin)是一项杰出的成就。你果断的行动粉碎了敌人反击我军的能力，让中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)永远失去了重夺符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)的希望。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The consolidation of Southeast Asia into a bastion of opposition against the dissolute squanderings of Western corruption is at hand. The Americans, however, have bullied the Republic of Singapore into accepting plans for an American base on the western end of the island to replace Subic Bay. Needless to say, this is an unacceptable threat to the security of the People’s Republic of China. You must drive the enemy into the ocean and seize the island of Singapore securing complete control of the Malay Peninsula.
译文）184 条: 把东南亚(Southeast Asia)整合成反抗西方腐朽、挥霍无度的一座堡垒，已近在眼前。然而美国(America)已威逼新加坡共和国(Republic of Singapore)接受在岛西端设立美军基地以替代苏比克湾(Subic Bay)的计划。不必说，这对中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)的安全是不可接受的威胁。你必须把敌人赶下海，夺取新加坡岛，从而完全控制马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The consolidation of Southeast Asia into a bastion of opposition against the dissolute wastfulness of Western corruption is at hand. The United Nations, with monetary backing from the Western powers, have bullied the Republic of Singapore into fighting the liberation from Western social evils. You must drive the enemy into the ocean and seize the island of Singapore securing complete control of the Malay Peninsula.
译文）184 条: 把东南亚(Southeast Asia)整合成反抗西方腐朽、肆意挥霍的一座堡垒，已近在眼前。联合国(United Nations)靠西方列强的金钱撑腰，威逼新加坡共和国(Republic of Singapore)为「摆脱西方社会弊病」的解放而战。你必须把敌人赶下海，夺取新加坡岛，从而完全控制马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The crumbling alliance of the Western nations has managed to assemble significant forces on the Malay Peninsula in a last ditch effort to hold on to their imperialist possessions. As the only modern port on the west coast of Malaysia, the capture of Penang is critical to our efforts of strengthening our defenses against the threats from the west. You must advance across the Rai River to seize Penang, and secure the roads south in preparation for an assault on Singapore.
译文）184 条: 摇摇欲坠的西方各国联盟，仍在马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)集结了相当兵力，做保住其帝国主义地盘的最后挣扎。作为马来西亚(Malaysia)西岸唯一的现代港口，攻占槟城(Penang)对我们加强西面防御、应对来自西方的威胁至关重要。你必须渡过莱河(Rai River)夺取槟城，并控制南下的公路，为进攻新加坡(Singapore)做准备。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The crumbling alliance of the Western nations has managed to back significant forces on the Malay Peninsula in a last ditch effort to hold on to their imperialist possessions. As the only modern port on the west coast of Malaysia, the capture of Penang is critical in our efforts towards strengthening our defenses against the threats from the west.
译文）184 条: 摇摇欲坠的西方各国联盟，仍在马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)拼凑了相当兵力，做保住其帝国主义地盘的最后挣扎。作为马来西亚(Malaysia)西岸唯一的现代港口，攻占槟城(Penang)对我们加强西面防御、应对来自西方的威胁至关重要。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The debacle in Burma which resulted from your failure to secure Rangoon has left the People’s Republic of China with insufficient forces to defend its interests in Southeast Asia. The Americans are poised to invade Vietnam. You are responsible for the extreme costs your ill-advised tactics caused and will report directly to the Chinese High Command for an accounting of your actions.
译文）184 条: 你在缅甸(Burma)因未能拿下仰光(Rangoon)而酿成的惨败，使中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)兵力不足，无力维护其在东南亚(Southeast Asia)的利益。美国人已蓄势待发，准备入侵越南(Vietnam)。你那些失当战术造成的巨大损失由你负责，你将直接向中国最高统帅部报到、就自己的行动作出交代。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The debacle in Thailand which resulted from your failure to secure Bangkok has left the People’s Republic of China with insufficient forces to defend its interests in Southeast Asia. The Americans are poised to invade Vietnam. You are responsible for the extreme costs your ill-advised tactics caused and will report directly to the Chinese High Command for an accounting of your actions.
译文）184 条: 你在泰国(Thailand)因未能拿下曼谷(Bangkok)而酿成的惨败，使中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)兵力不足，无力维护其在东南亚(Southeast Asia)的利益。美国人已蓄势待发，准备入侵越南(Vietnam)。你那些失当战术造成的巨大损失由你负责，你将直接向中国最高统帅部报到、就自己的行动作出交代。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The debacle in Thailand which resulted from your failure to secure Bangkok has left the Socialist Republic of Vietnam with insufficient forces to defend its interests in Southeast Asia. U.N. forces are poised to invade Vietnam. You are responsible for the extreme costs your ill-advised tactics caused and will report directly to the Prime Minister to account for of your actions.
译文）184 条: 你在泰国(Thailand)因未能拿下曼谷(Bangkok)而酿成的惨败，使越南社会主义共和国(Socialist Republic of Vietnam)兵力不足，无力维护其在东南亚(Southeast Asia)的利益。联合国(UN)部队已蓄势待发，准备入侵越南。你那些失当战术造成的巨大损失由你负责，你将直接向总理报到、就自己的行动作出交代。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The decadent wastes of a corrupted nation are nowhere more evident than the pollution permeating the industrial belt around Kazan. Nevertheless, it is a strategic prize that will serve as a bulwark against the troops stationed in defense of Moscow. You must take Kazan quickly and push the advance west across the Volga River to secure the region.
译文）184 条: 一个腐朽国家的颓败，在喀山(Kazan)周边工业带上弥漫的污染中体现得再清楚不过。但无论如何，它仍是一份战略重利，可作为抵御驻守莫斯科(Moscow)之敌的屏障。你必须迅速拿下喀山，并向西推进、渡过伏尔加河(Volga)以巩固该地区。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The decadent wastes of a corrupted nation are nowhere more evident than the pollution permeating the industrial belt around Kazan. You must take Kazan quickly and push the advance west across the Volga River to secure the region.
译文）184 条: 一个腐朽国家的颓败，在喀山(Kazan)周边工业带上弥漫的污染中体现得再清楚不过。你必须迅速拿下喀山，并向西推进、渡过伏尔加河(Volga)以巩固该地区。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The dragon is missing a few teeth after your triumphant assault on Hanoi. The Western nations have never appeared stronger than they do with the liberation of Vietnam and the expulsion of China from Southeast Asia that you brought about. It is an accomplishment you can look on with pride, as the chances for long term stability in the region rise to new heights.
译文）184 条: 在你对河内(Hanoi)的凯旋式强攻之后，这条巨龙已被敲掉几颗牙。随着你带来的越南(Vietnam)解放和中国被逐出东南亚(Southeast Asia)，西方国家从未显得如此强大。这是你足以为之自豪的成就——这一地区实现长期稳定的机会，正升上前所未有的高度。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The final key to controlling Korea is its port city Pusan at the southern tip of the peninsula. Its capture will signal the reunification of North and South Korea, as well as expell the last vestige of Western influence from the region. The dragon is poised to reveal its unrivaled power and you must complete its rise. Drive all enemy forces from the Korean Peninsula and seize Pusan.
译文）184 条: 控制朝鲜(Korea)的最后一环，是半岛南端的港口城市釜山(Pusan)。夺取它，就意味着朝鲜与韩国(North and South Korea)的重新统一，也意味着把西方在这一地区的最后残余影响彻底逐出。这条巨龙即将展露其无可匹敌的力量，而你必须完成它的崛起。把所有敌军逐出朝鲜半岛(Korean Peninsula)，夺取釜山。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The horde you failed to stop in Kazan is advancing at a breakneck pace towards Moscow. Your defeat has left the Secretary General no option but to abandon all forward operations and prepare for a purely defensive stance.
译文）184 条: 你在喀山(Kazan)未能挡住的那股洪流，正以惊人的速度向莫斯科(Moscow)逼近。你的失利让秘书长别无选择，只能放弃一切前线行动，转入纯防御态势。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The key to controlling Korea is its major port, Pusan, at the southern tip of the peninsula. Drive all enemy forces from the Korean Peninsula and seize Pusan.
译文）184 条: 控制朝鲜(Korea)的关键，是半岛南端的主要港口釜山(Pusan)。把所有敌军逐出朝鲜半岛(Korean Peninsula)，夺取釜山。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The key to the Russian Far East is the port of Vladivostok. You must quickly capture the cities along the Trans-Siberian Railroad leading to Vladivostok and secure your eastern flank at Suchan.
译文）184 条: 俄罗斯远东(Russian Far East)的关键，是符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)港。你必须迅速夺取西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)沿线通往符拉迪沃斯托克的城镇，并在苏昌(Suchan)保障你的东翼。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The last Chinese toehold in the Russian Far East is at Khabarovsk. Hoping to gain some political advantage, the People's Republic is gathering all available reserves to hold this last section of foreign land. It is imperative that you break this stronghold showing the world that the Dragon has been slain. You must capture the city of Khabarovsk and drive south of the Ussuri River into China.
译文）184 条: 中国在俄罗斯远东(Russian Far East)的最后一个据点是哈巴罗夫斯克(Khabarovsk)。为谋取一些政治好处，中华人民共和国(People's Republic)正把所有可用的预备队调来守住这最后一片外国土地。你必须攻破这个据点，向世界表明这条巨龙已被斩杀。你要夺取哈巴罗夫斯克城，并向南越过乌苏里江(Ussuri River)进入中国。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The loss of Penang is a misfortune of far reaching consequences. Your lack of resolve in serving the People’s Republic of China has revealed your inability to appreciate the need for resourceful leadership. The Chinese High Command has dispatched a replacement for you who better understands the importance of achieving the objectives at hand.
译文）184 条: 丢掉槟城(Penang)是一场影响深远的灾祸。你在为中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)效力时缺乏决心，暴露出你认识不到足智多谋的领导有多必要。中国最高统帅部已派来接替你的人，他更懂得达成眼前目标的重要性。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The loss of Penang is a misfortune of far reaching consequences. Your lack of resolve in serving the nation has revealed an inability to provide the need for resourceful leadership. The Prime Minister has dispatched a replacement for you who better understands the importance of achieving the objectives at hand.
译文）184 条: 丢掉槟城(Penang)是一场影响深远的灾祸。你在为国家效力时缺乏决心，暴露出你无力提供足智多谋的领导。总理已派来接替你的人，他更懂得达成眼前目标的重要性。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The loss of Taejon has allowed the Americans time to land at Pusan, ending any further operations on the Korean Peninsula. You will depart immediately for a personal accounting to the Chinese High Command.
译文）184 条: 丢掉大田(Taejon)，让美国(America)得以在釜山(Pusan)登陆，朝鲜半岛(Korean Peninsula)上的一切后续行动就此终结。你将立即启程，亲自向中国最高统帅部作出交代。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The loss of Ulan Ude put an end to any hope of continuing our advance into Siberia. The Russians are undermining China’s authority with their hollow rhetoric of independence for Mongolia. You are ordered to cease all offensive operations and deploy an occupation force in Mongolia until your replacement arrives.
译文）184 条: 丢掉乌兰乌德(Ulan Ude)，断送了我们继续向西伯利亚(Siberia)推进的一切希望。俄罗斯人正用「蒙古(Mongolia)独立」的空话来动摇中国的权威。你奉命停止一切进攻行动，在蒙古部署一支占领军，直到接替你的人到来。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The magnitude of your loss is immense. The People’s Republic of China has gained the upper hand in the Russian Far East. The threat from expanded Chinese air power on the island has halted the advance on Vladivostok while our reserves must be diverted north to guard the Tartar Strait. It will be some time before we can regroup for another assault. You will be serving stateside when that happens.
译文）184 条: 你这场失利的规模极为巨大。中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)已在俄罗斯远东(Russian Far East)占据上风。中国在该岛扩充的空中力量，威胁已然中止了我们对符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)的推进，我们的预备队又必须北调去防守鞑靼海峡(Tartar Strait)。我们要重新集结、再度进攻，还得等上一段时日。到那时，你将在国内服役。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The port of George Town (Penang), situated on the western coast of the Malay Peninsula, is critical as a supply line for our shipping which to avoid the dangerous passage across the South China Sea. The retreating People's Liberation Army is, however, laying in wait along the only roads through the rough terrain. You will need to guard against exposing your command to ambush. An attachment of Australian troops are assigned to assist your advance. You must quickly recapture George Town and secure our flank east of the Rai River before the Chinese can relieve their faltering army.
译文）184 条: 位于马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)西岸的乔治市(George Town，即槟城 Penang)港，对我方为避开危险的南海(South China Sea)航段而设的航运补给线至关重要。然而撤退中的中国人民解放军(People's Liberation Army)正沿穿越崎岖地形仅有的几条公路设伏。你必须提防暴露行踪、遭敌伏击。一支澳大利亚(Australia)部队已受命协助你推进。你必须迅速夺回乔治市，并在中国军队接应其摇摇欲坠的部队之前，保障莱河(Rai River)以东的侧翼。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The rebels, who continue to defy all civilized conventions, stand at Ekaterinburg, the gateway to the Urals. The Chinese continue to strip Russia of its precious resources. Your forces must return civilization to this bastion of the barbarous hordes.
译文）184 条: 那些继续无视一切文明准则的叛军，盘踞在乌拉尔(Urals)门户叶卡捷琳堡(Ekaterinburg)。中国仍在不断掠走俄罗斯(Russia)的宝贵资源。你的部队必须把文明带回这座野蛮部落的堡垒。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The region near Khabarovsk has long been under territorial dispute between the Russians and Chinese. It is imperative that the Russian border is established in no uncertain terms. You must recapture Khabarovsk from the rebels and keep the Chinese forces in their positions south of the Ussuri River.
译文）184 条: 哈巴罗夫斯克(Khabarovsk)附近地区长期以来是俄中之间的领土争端所在。明确划定俄罗斯边界势在必行。你必须从叛军手中夺回哈巴罗夫斯克，并把中国军队压制在乌苏里江(Ussuri River)以南的阵地上。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The retreating army of the People’s Republic of China is laying in wait along the roads to George Town. You must quickly capture George Town (Penang) and secure your flank east of the Rai River before the Chinese can relieve their faltering army.
译文）184 条: 撤退中的中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)军队正沿通往乔治市(George Town)的公路设伏。你必须迅速夺取乔治市(槟城 Penang)，并在中国军队接应其摇摇欲坠的部队之前，保障莱河(Rai River)以东的侧翼。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The so-called liberation of Taiwan by the People’s Republic of China must end. A massive invasion fleet stormed the beaches in the South-West. Expand the landings at Wuchieh, destroy all enemy resistance on the island, and recapture Taipei.
译文）184 条: 中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)对中国台湾(Taiwan)的所谓「解放」必须终结。一支庞大的入侵舰队已经从西南方向冲上滩头。扩大梧栖(Wuchieh)的登陆场，肃清岛上一切敌军抵抗，夺回台北(Taipei)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The so-called liberation of Taiwan by the People’s Republic of China must end. Expand the landings at Wuchieh, destroy all enemy resistance on the island, and recapture Taipei.
译文）184 条: 中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)对中国台湾(Taiwan)的所谓「解放」必须终结。扩大梧栖(Wuchieh)的登陆场，肃清岛上一切敌军抵抗，夺回台北(Taipei)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The taking of Taejon was only a stepping stone, but with it you have won a tremendous advantage over our foes. Greatness, like the unfolding of the thousand petaled lotus, is made of the flawless execution of many small actions.
译文）184 条: 拿下大田(Taejon)只是垫脚石，但凭此你已在我们对手面前赢得巨大优势。伟大，就像千瓣莲花的绽放，是由许多微小动作的完美执行造就的。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The triumph of the Government of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam on the Malay Peninsula is a victory worthy of our greatest ancestors. With your dramatic expulsion of the Western Imperialists, you have raised a banner of freedom for the people of Southeast Asia. The Prime Minister gratefully acknowledges your most impressive triumph.
译文）184 条: 越南社会主义共和国(Socialist Republic of Vietnam)政府在马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)的胜利，是一场无愧于我们最伟大祖先的胜利。你以雷霆之势驱逐西方帝国主义者，为东南亚(Southeast Asia)人民举起了自由的旗帜。总理满怀感激地肯定你这无比辉煌的功绩。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The triumph of the People’s Republic of China in reclaiming its traditional territories and restoring its dominance in the Far East hinges on neutralizing our northern menace, Russia. Isolating and capturing Khabarovsk is critical to the success of our expected rise in authority. To that end, you are to cross the Amur River into Russia and take Khabarovsk
译文）184 条: 中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)要收复其传统领土、重树在远东(Far East)的支配地位，其成败系于能否解除北面的威胁——俄罗斯(Russia)。孤立并夺取哈巴罗夫斯克(Khabarovsk)，对我们预期中的地位跃升至关重要。为此，你要越过黑龙江(Amur River)进入俄罗斯，夺取哈巴罗夫斯克。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The triumph of the People’s Republic of China on the Malay Peninsula is a victory worthy of our greatest ancestors, and the Premier gratefully acknowledges your most capable abilities. With your dramatic expulsion of the Western Imperialists, you have raised an impenetrable wall for the enduring security of our nation.
译文）184 条: 中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)在马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)的胜利，是一场无愧于我们最伟大祖先的胜利，总理满怀感激地肯定你的卓越才干。你以雷霆之势驱逐西方帝国主义者，为我们国家的长治久安筑起了一道不可逾越的墙。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The vastness of Siberian wilderness makes logistical support the critical factor in our strategy to free Irkutsk and break the stranglehold that the People’s Republic of China has placed on the region. You must capture Irkutsk and Baykal to secure the vital supply lines along the Trans-Siberian Railroad.
译文）184 条: 西伯利亚(Siberia)荒野的广袤，使我们战略中的后勤支援成为关键——要解放伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)、打破中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)对该地区的扼制。你必须夺取伊尔库茨克和贝加尔(Baykal)，以保障西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)沿线的关键补给线。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The victory you achieved in capturing Khabarovsk has the people of Russia chanting your name in the streets of Moscow. It is curses, though, that you receive from the rebels who relied on their former Chinese ally.
译文）184 条: 你夺取哈巴罗夫斯克(Khabarovsk)的胜利，让俄罗斯(Russia)人民在莫斯科(Moscow)街头高呼你的名字。而依靠昔日中国盟友的叛军，送给你的却是咒骂。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The victory you achieved near Vladivostok has the people of Russia chanting your name. The Chinese High Command, manuvering an army that relies on strength in numbers, simply cannot react swiftly enough to escape the rush of your advance.
译文）184 条: 你在符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)附近的胜利，让俄罗斯(Russia)人民高呼你的名字。中国最高统帅部指挥的是一支靠人海取胜的军队，根本来不及迅速反应，以躲开你推进的洪流。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: The world witnessed a tragic episode in the fight against tyranny when your forces were shattered on the Malay Peninsula. The Chinese are reinforcing their positions throughout Southeast Asia, and with our forces weakened by your defeat at George Town, the chance of any further offensive operations is nonexistent.
译文）184 条: 当你的部队在马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)被击碎时，世界目睹了这场反抗暴政斗争中的悲惨一幕。中国正加强其在东南亚(Southeast Asia)全境的阵地；而我军经你在乔治市(George Town)的失利已大为削弱，任何进一步攻势的机会都不复存在。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: This is a victory Commander, another quick blow and this revolution will be over!
译文）184 条: 这是一场胜利，指挥官——再猛击一下，这场革命就结束了！

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Triumph! Your masterful victory at Khabarovsk dealt a mortal blow to the dragon.
译文）184 条: 胜利！你在哈巴罗夫斯克(Khabarovsk)的高超胜利，给了这条巨龙致命一击。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Triumph! Your masterful victory at Khabarovsk dealt a mortal blow to the dragon. The People’s Republic of China has sued for peace, offering substantial concessions in order to avoid the embarrassment of an invasion of China, including complete independence for Taiwan. Celebrations erupted the world over as newscasts of the surrendering Chinese army spread. It seems your next tour will be the parade of a hero who liberated a continent.
译文）184 条: 胜利！你在哈巴罗夫斯克(Khabarovsk)的高超胜利，给了这条巨龙致命一击。中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)已请求议和，为免遭入侵之辱，开出了重大让步：包括台湾(Taiwan)完全独立。中国军队投降的消息一经播出，世界各地一片欢腾。看来你的下一站行程，将是一位解放了整个大陆的英雄的阅兵式。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: U.N. indecision to take action in Korea led to a U.S. evacuation of Pusan as the Eastern armies crushed any cities in its path. A month later, the U.S. takes matters into its own hands with an amphibious assault to recapture Pusan.
译文）184 条: 联合国(UN)在朝鲜(Korea)问题上迟迟不采取行动，导致美国(America)在东方军队一路碾碎沿途城市之际从釜山(Pusan)撤离。一个月后，美国亲自出手，以两栖突击夺回釜山。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: U.S. forces land in Vietnam and race to capture Ho Chi Minh City in order to secure a northern foothold in Southeast Asia and force the People's Republic of China to withdraw.
译文）184 条: 美军在越南(Vietnam)登陆，急速突进夺取胡志明市(Ho Chi Minh City)，以在东南亚(Southeast Asia)取得一处北面立足点，迫使中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)撤军。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Victory is a fortune the bold make for themselves, and yours has earned China great rewards. The Russian Far East is all but secure as the capture of the Trans-Siberian Railroad at Irkutsk will ensure our forces of a reliable supply line.
译文）184 条: 胜利是勇者为自己争得的运气，而你的胜利为中国赢来了丰厚的回报。俄罗斯远东(Russian Far East)已基本安全无虞——夺取伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)的西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)，将确保我军拥有一条可靠的补给线。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Vietnam represents an intimidating stronghold for the People’s Republic of China in Southeast Asia and will continue to threaten the security of the Western nations until China’s power there has been neutralized. The liberation of Thailand, however, has left their southern forces in Ho Chi Minh City exposed. There is no better time for our invasion. A U.S. return to Ho Chi Minh City carries with it an importance far greater than the capture of a strategic objective: failure here could spell destruction for the Western alliance. You will begin the invasion at Phu’o’c Tho, then advance north and west to secure the roads and take Ho Chi Minh City.
译文）184 条: 越南(Vietnam)是中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)在东南亚(Southeast Asia)令人生畏的一座堡垒；除非中国在那里的力量被解除，否则它将继续威胁西方各国的安全。不过，解放泰国(Thailand)已使他们在胡志明市(Ho Chi Minh City)的南方部队暴露出来。没有比现在更好的入侵时机了。美军重返胡志明市的意义，远不止夺取一个战略目标：在此失败有可能意味着西方联盟的毁灭。你将从福寿(Phu'o'c Tho)发起入侵，随后向北、向西推进，控制公路并夺取胡志明市。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: We counted on you General and you didn't disapoint us. With the Chinese fortified line defeated Volgograd stands open to our attack. Well done!
译文）184 条: 我们寄望于你，将军，你没有让我们失望。中国防线既已被击破，伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)就对我们敞开了。干得好！

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: We have secured a small beachead on the island. You orders are to liberate the island and its inhabitants. Capturing the imperialist den of Taipei is mandatory.
译文）184 条: 我们已在岛上取得一处小登陆场。你的命令是解放该岛及其居民。夺取帝国主义老巢台北(Taipei)是必须完成的。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: We will strike the Chinese army where they least expect it. As our most experienced and decorated commander, you and your troops have been honored with the assignment to free Southeast Asia. Your goal is the liberation of Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, and the destruction of Chinese armies in Southeast Asia.
译文）184 条: 我们将在中国人最料想不到的地方打击他们。作为我们最有经验、受勋最多的指挥官，你和你的部队被授予解放东南亚(Southeast Asia)的重任。你的目标是解放新加坡(Singapore)、马来西亚(Malaysia)、泰国(Thailand)、越南(Vietnam)，并歼灭东南亚的中国军队。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Western forces launch a counterattack designed to recapture Bangkok, driving deep into the Chinese held positions in Thailand.
译文）184 条: 西方部队发动反攻，意在夺回曼谷(Bangkok)，并深入泰国(Thailand)境内的中国占领区。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: While we were busy in the south, China decided to stab us in the back. They launched a surprise invasion of our country and captured our capitol, Hanoi. This forced us to withdraw from our recent liberated countries and prepare for a counter-offensive against China. As our most gifter commander you are to push Chinese forces back and retake Hanoi.
译文）184 条: 当我们忙于南方之际，中国在背后捅了我们一刀。他们突袭入侵我国，占领了我们的首都河内(Hanoi)。这迫使我们从新近解放的国家撤军，准备对中国发起反攻。作为我们最有天赋的指挥官，你要把中国军队打回去，夺回河内。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: While you were busy in the south, Chinese forces launched a counter-offensive against our line at Kazan. The Chinese are mobilizing additional forces to protect their hold on it. You must move quickly to retake Kazan before they cross the Urals.
译文）184 条: 当你忙于南方之际，中国军队对我军在喀山(Kazan)的防线发起反攻。中国正调集更多兵力保护其对喀山的控制。你必须在他们越过乌拉尔(Urals)之前迅速夺回喀山。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: With Eastern forces holding Irkutsk, you must find a way to rout them back to Lake Baikal.
译文）184 条: 东方军队既已据守伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)，你必须设法把他们赶回贝加尔湖(Lake Baikal)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: With Mongolia now securely in the protective sphere of the People’s Republic of China, the Chinese High Command has stepped up the timetable for the invasion of middle Siberia. Our first objective is Ulan Ude, a vital industrial center on the Selenga River, which provides an ideal base for our push into Siberia. You must drive up the Selenga River, capture Ulan Ude, and secure the river crossings for the Trans-Siberian Railroad to the west.
译文）184 条: 蒙古(Mongolia)如今已稳稳落入中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)的势力范围，中国最高统帅部因而加快了入侵中西伯利亚(Siberia)的时间表。我们的首要目标是乌兰乌德(Ulan Ude)——色楞格河(Selenga River)上的重要工业中心，也是我们挺进西伯利亚的理想基地。你必须沿色楞格河北上，夺取乌兰乌德，并保障西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)西向的过河通道。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: With Russia fast crumbling in the war with the People's Republic of China, Japan invades Sakhalin to reclaim the island before China can threaten its northern borders.
译文）184 条: 趁着俄罗斯(Russia)在对华战争中迅速崩溃，日本(Japan)入侵萨哈林(Sakhalin)，意图在中国威胁其北方边境之前夺回该岛。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: With Russia strangling their supply lines to the south, the Chinese forces in Irkutsk rush to dig in as U.S. troops launch an assault on the city.
译文）184 条: 俄罗斯(Russia)掐断了中国军队向南的补给线，伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)的中国部队慌忙就地构筑工事，而美军已对该城发起强攻。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: With the People's Republic of China assembling troops in Khabarovsk to push back the advance of the Western forces, Russia and the U.S. launch a surprise attack across the Amur River.
译文）184 条: 中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)正在哈巴罗夫斯克(Khabarovsk)集结兵力，企图打退西方部队的推进；俄罗斯(Russia)与美国(America)则越过阿穆尔河(Amur River)发起突袭。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: With the People’s Republic of China reeling from the bloody nose they received at Ho Chi Minh City, our forces are poised to deliver a knock-out blow. After a fiercely contested landing, the port of Hai Phong surrendered. The Chinese, though, are dug in deeply at Hanoi and you will need more than a few well-aimed strikes to dislodge them. Take your forces, drive across the Red River to seize Hanoi, and eliminate any vestige of Chinese presence in the region.
译文）184 条: 中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)在胡志明市(Ho Chi Minh City)碰得头破血流，我军已蓄势待发，准备给予其决定性一击。经过一场争夺激烈的登陆战，海防(Hai Phong)港投降。不过，中国军队在河内(Hanoi)深沟高垒，你需要不止几次精准打击才能把他们赶走。带上你的部队，跨过红河(Red River)夺取河内，消除中国在这一地区存在的一切痕迹。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: With the Russians having fallen on hard times, the Chinese seeing an opportunity to gain resources have expanded their northern border Kazan. Russia has called for help in restoring order into this wild region.
译文）184 条: 趁着俄罗斯人陷入困境，中国人看到攫取资源的机会，把北部边界推向了喀山(Kazan)。俄罗斯(Russia)已请求援助，以恢复这片荒野地区的秩序。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: With the Russians having fallen on hard times, the people of Siberia have revolted. The Chinese, seeing an opportunity to gain resources, have expanded their northern border into Irkutsk and Khabarovsk. Russia has called for help in restoring order into this wild region. The Trans-Siberian Railroad is the critical link in all of our upcoming operations against the Russian rebels and their Chinese allies.
译文）184 条: 趁着俄罗斯人陷入困境，西伯利亚(Siberia)人民发动了起义。中国人看到攫取资源的机会，把北部边界扩展到了伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)和哈巴罗夫斯克(Khabarovsk)。俄罗斯(Russia)已请求援助，以恢复这片荒野地区的秩序。西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)是我们即将展开的一切行动的关键节点——无论是对俄罗斯叛军，还是对他们的中国盟友。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: With the Western powers still recovering from their losses in Russia, the Vietnamese are vulnerable to a swift assault down the coast. Completing the conquest of Vietnam should destroy their resistance and solidify our position in Indochina. You must capture Ho Chi Minh City and stop any Western incursions.
译文）184 条: 趁西方列强仍在舔舐在俄罗斯(Russia)的伤口，越南(Vietnam)招架不住一场沿海南下的快速突击。完成对越南的征服，应能摧毁其抵抗、巩固我们在中南半岛(Indochina)的地位。你必须夺取胡志明市(Ho Chi Minh City)，阻止西方任何侵犯。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: With the elimination of the Russian Bear the true objective of Plan Red can now be realized. Fresh from your victory at Volgograd, you have been given the responsibility of seizing Southeast Asia. Your objectives are the elimination of Western influence in Southeast Asia, and ultimately, capture of the vital port of Singapore. This gains the Chinese nation easy access to the newly developed oil fields in the Spratly Islands. The world watches as order is returned to all of Asia under the flag of China.
译文）184 条: 俄罗斯熊既已除去，红色方案(Plan Red)的真正目标现在可以实现了。你在伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)的胜利刚告捷，夺取东南亚(Southeast Asia)的重任就落到了你肩上。你的目标是消除西方在东南亚的影响，最终夺取重要港口新加坡(Singapore)。这将让中华民族轻松取得南沙群岛(Spratly Islands)新开发的油田。全世界都注视着亚洲在中国旗帜下重归秩序。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: With your victory at Ekaterinburg, the People’s Republic of China has earned rich rewards. Along with the raw minerals in the region, the massive machine complex at Uralmash and the power plant at Beloyarskoye give China the ability to devote even more resources to military production.
译文）184 条: 凭你在叶卡捷琳堡(Ekaterinburg)的胜利，中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)赢得了丰厚的回报。除了该地区的原矿，乌拉尔机械厂(Uralmash)的庞大机械联合体和别洛亚尔斯基(Beloyarskoye)的发电厂，让中国有能力把更多资源投入军工生产。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: You are to defeat the last remnants of the Thai army and then defeat the imperialists defending Rangoon.
译文）184 条: 你要歼灭泰国(Thailand)军队的最后残余，然后再击败防守仰光(Rangoon)的帝国主义者。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: You are to launch a thrust at Almaty near Chinese border in Kazakhstan. Your objectives will be to free Almaty and secure the roads east to Karakamyr.
译文）184 条: 你要向哈萨克斯坦(Kazakhstan)境内、靠近中国边界的阿拉木图(Almaty)发起突击。你的目标是解放阿拉木图，并控制东通卡拉卡米尔(Karakamyr)的公路。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: You are to strike from the port city of Pusan, and take the cities of Masan, Ulsan, and Miryang, as a stepping stone to freeing the South Korean capital of Seoul. What is left of the South Korean Army is there to provide assistance. Good Luck.
译文）184 条: 你要从釜山(Pusan)港出击，夺取马山(Masan)、蔚山(Ulsan)和密阳(Miryang)，作为解放韩国首都首尔(Seoul)的垫脚石。韩国军队的残部将在那里提供协助。祝你好运。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: You gave the world a bitter pill to swallow with your appalling loss north of Vladivostok. It might be best if you emmigrate to a non-member nation.
译文）184 条: 你在符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)以北的惨败，让全世界咽下了一颗苦果。你最好还是移民到一个非成员国去。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: You gave the world a bitter pill to swallow with your appalling loss north of Vladivostok. The People’s Republic of China has solidified its defenses in the region and throughout all of Manchuria, making further attempts to recapture the port unlikely any time in the near future. The Joint Chiefs of Staff consider it advisable that you fade into obscurity and have ordered your transfer to records management with the National Archives.
译文）184 条: 你在符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)以北的惨败，让全世界咽下了一颗苦果。中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)已加强了该地区乃至整个满洲(Manchuria)的防御，短期内再想夺回该港已无可能。参谋长联席会议(Joint Chiefs of Staff)认为，你最好就此淡出、隐没无闻，已下令把你调往国家档案馆(National Archives)管理档案。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: You must avenge a past defeat. It was at Volgograd that a defeated Russian nation sued for peace.
译文）184 条: 你必须为过去的一场败仗复仇。正是在伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)，战败的俄罗斯国家请求了议和。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: You must avenge a past defeat. It was at Volgograd that a defeated Russian nation sued for peace. It is to be here that we launch the re-conquest of Siberia and the Russian Far East.  A humiliated Russia, ready for vengeance, needs only a spark of hope to rejoin the effort to free Asia.
译文）184 条: 你必须为过去的一场败仗复仇。正是在伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)，战败的俄罗斯国家请求了议和。我们将从这里发起对西伯利亚(Siberia)和俄罗斯远东(Russian Far East)的反攻。一个受尽屈辱、蓄势复仇的俄罗斯(Russia)，只需要一点希望的火花，就会重新加入解放亚洲(Asia)的行动。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: You must establish a secure area around the city. Push the remaining russian forces and their allies to the Don. This would ensure our domination in Volgograd and will force Russia to capitulate.
译文）184 条: 你必须在城市周边建立一片安全区。把残余的俄军及其盟友逼向顿河(Don)。这将确保我们对伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)的控制，并迫使俄罗斯(Russia)投降。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your assault on Ulan Ude effectively clipped the dragon’s wings, leaving the People’s Republic of China incapable of supporting its own weight. No longer will the Chinese be able to plunder Russia’s resources or industrial capabilities to replace their battered equipment. With a few better-aimed attacks, the world will be free of China’s oppression.
译文）184 条: 你对乌兰乌德(Ulan Ude)的进攻，等于剪断了巨龙的翅膀，让中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)再也支撑不起自身的重量。中国人再也无法掠夺俄罗斯(Russia)的资源与工业能力来补充其残破的装备。只要再来几次更精准的打击，世界就将摆脱中国的压迫。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your assault on Ulan Ude has left the People’s Republic of China incapable of supporting the rebels. No longer will the Chinese be able to plunder Russia’s resources or industrial capabilities to replace their battered equipment.
译文）184 条: 你对乌兰乌德(Ulan Ude)的进攻，已让中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)无力支持叛军。中国人再也无法掠夺俄罗斯(Russia)的资源与工业能力来补充其残破的装备。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your command will be split into two groups. One will take Hue. The other one must attack Da Nang. Select your best troops for the offensive and take advantage of the surprise.
译文）184 条: 你的部队将分为两组。一组夺取顺化(Hue)，另一组必须进攻岘港(Da Nang)。为进攻挑选你最好的部队，好好利用这次奇袭。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your conquest of the South Korean Peninsula and recapture of Seoul has sent the North Korean diplomats scurrying to sign treaties. Hoping to keep their sovereignty, they have accepted our terms and have withdrawn from active conflict. Excellent job, commander.  You have won an "unwinable" war.
译文）184 条: 你征服朝鲜半岛(South Korean Peninsula)并夺回首尔(Seoul)，已让朝鲜(North Korea)的外交官慌忙跑去签约。为保住主权，他们接受了我们的条件，退出了实际冲突。干得漂亮，指挥官。你打赢了一场「打不赢」的战争。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your conquest of the South Korean Peninsula and recapture of Seoul has sent the North Korean diplomats scurrying to sign treaties. Hoping to keep their sovereignty, they have accepted our terms and have withdrawn from active conflict. In light of North Korea's capitulation, the High Command has decided to switch the focus of our offensive.
译文）184 条: 你征服朝鲜半岛(South Korean Peninsula)并夺回首尔(Seoul)，已让朝鲜(North Korea)的外交官慌忙跑去签约。为保住主权，他们接受了我们的条件，退出了实际冲突。鉴于朝鲜的屈服，最高统帅部决定转换我军的进攻重点。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your defeat at Ekaterinburg has not only squandered troops but valuable equipment as well. Without the mineral wealth of the Urals, we can no longer sustain the expenditure of resources that the war demands. It is time you joined the steelworkers in order to replace the assets that you wasted.
译文）184 条: 你在叶卡捷琳堡(Ekaterinburg)的失利，不只是浪费了兵力，也浪费了宝贵的装备。失去乌拉尔(Urals)的矿产，我们再也无力支撑这场战争所需的资源消耗。该是你去当炼钢工人、把你糟蹋掉的资产补回来的时候了。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your defeat at Hanoi has gutted our forces and left the door open for the People’s Republic of China to launch a counteroffensive that could sweep away all our hard won gains. The Western forces have already begun their evacuation of Ho Chi Minh City while the British have abandoned their interests in Malaysia. You are relieved of your command.
译文）184 条: 你在河内(Hanoi)的失利掏空了我军，也为中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)发动反攻、一举扫掉我们辛苦得来的一切战果敞开了大门。西方部队已开始从胡志明市(Ho Chi Minh City)撤离，英国也放弃了它在马来西亚(Malaysia)的利益。你被解除指挥权。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your defeat at Irkutsk was a grave miscalculation that the West could ill-afford. The Chinese shifted the bulk of their armies to the north and launched a counterstrike on Novosibirsk that has effectively pocketed the Russian troops that were en route to join your army. With your forces already decimated, there is no way to prevent their slaughter. You have been allowed to surrender what remains of your command to the People’s Republic of China.
译文）184 条: 你在伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)的失利，是西方承受不起的严重误判。中国把主力北调，对新西伯利亚(Novosibirsk)发起反击，已有效地把正在开赴并入你部的那支俄军装进了口袋。你的部队既已被打残，他们的覆灭已无法阻止。你已被允许把你残存的部队向中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)投降。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your defeat at Vladivostok is a devastating blow to our efforts. With the port now securely in the hands of the enemy, the Chinese High Command has no alternative but to order a withdrawal from the region, and a termination of your command.
译文）184 条: 你在符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)的失利，对我军是一场毁灭性打击。港口如今稳稳落入敌手，中国最高统帅部别无选择，只能下令从该地区撤退，并终止你的指挥权。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your defeat at Volgograd is a disaster of unthinkable magnitude, matched only by the mistake of entrusting you with command. Our positions throughout Russia are now threatened with collapse as their idolatrous cries for the defense of ‘Mother Russia’ have inspired fanatic attacks against our forces in the Urals. Many have been successful. You are forthwith relieved of duty.
译文）184 条: 你在伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)的失利是一场难以想象的灾难，唯一能与之相比的，就是当初把指挥权交给你的那个错误。我们在俄罗斯(Russia)各地的阵地如今都面临崩溃——他们狂热地呼喊「保卫俄罗斯母亲(Mother Russia)」，煽动起对乌拉尔(Urals)我军部队的疯狂攻击，而且屡屡得手。你即刻被解除职务。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your defeat outside Seoul is a disgrace that cannot be atoned for. The Chinese High Command now sees a reunification of the Korean Peninsula as too costly to the stability of our recent gains. All forces have been ordered to withdraw from the conflict, and North Korean diplomats are en route to P’anmunjom to negotiate a treaty.
译文）184 条: 你在首尔(Seoul)城外的失利，是一桩无法赎补的耻辱。中国最高统帅部如今认为，统一朝鲜半岛(Korean Peninsula)对我们新近战果的稳定而言代价过高。所有部队已奉命退出冲突，朝鲜(North Korea)外交官正前往板门店(P'anmunjom)谈判签约。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your defense of Seoul was excellent!  It is incredibly bad luck that the Eastern flank of the Korean penninsula has collapsed over by Samchok.  The enemy is making a concerted drive on to Chipyong-ni and Wonju right down the center.  I'm ordering you to pull back so that they don't outflank you too.
译文）184 条: 你对首尔(Seoul)的防守极为出色！不幸的是，朝鲜半岛(Korean Peninsula)的东翼在三陟(Samchok)一带崩了，这运气简直坏到家了。敌人正集中兵力沿中路直扑砥平里(Chipyong-ni)和原州(Wonju)。我命令你后撤，别让他们也把你侧翼包抄了。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your extraordinary victory at Volgograd is a dagger in the heart of "Mother Russia". Russians are in retreat and the city is ours.
译文）184 条: 你在伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)的非凡胜利，是插进「俄罗斯母亲(Mother Russia)」心脏的一把匕首。俄军正在溃退，该城已归我们所有。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your extraordinary victory at Volgograd is a dagger in the heart of "Mother Russia". The Russian government has sued for peace and opposes us no longer.
译文）184 条: 你在伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)的非凡胜利，是插进「俄罗斯母亲(Mother Russia)」心脏的一把匕首。俄罗斯(Russia)政府已请求议和，不再是我们的敌人。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your extraordinary victory at Volgograd is a dagger in the heart of China. For now, the dagger remains in her heart, and China will trouble us a bit less for a little while.  That should give us just a little bit of breathing room!
译文）184 条: 你在伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)的非凡胜利，是插进中国心脏的一把匕首。眼下，这把匕首仍留在他心口，中国会消停一阵子。这该能给我们争取到一点点喘息的空间！

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your failure at Irkutsk was a mistake that we could ill-afford. The rebels and their Chinese allies will have another year to consolidate their forces and strip the region of valuable resources. The Russian President has asked for your head. You are to be quickly removed from the reach of the Russians.
译文）184 条: 你在伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)的失败，是我们承受不起的错误。叛军及其中国盟友又能多一年时间来整合兵力、掠走该地区的宝贵资源。俄罗斯总统已索要你的脑袋。你要尽快离开俄罗斯人的势力所及。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your failure to capture Taejon is a defeat from which the U.S. and our allies may well never recover. The People’s Republic of China has all but admitted its plans to conquer the entire Asian continent, and the only option left is a desperate gamble to recapture Seoul.
译文）184 条: 你未能夺取大田(Taejon)，这是一场美国(America)及其盟友或许再也无法翻身的败仗。中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)几乎已公开其征服整个亚洲大陆的计划，剩下的唯一选择，就是孤注一掷夺回首尔(Seoul)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your failure to capture Taejon is a defeat from which the U.S. and our allies may well never recover. The People’s Republic of China has all but admitted its plans to conquer the entire Korean penninsula, and the only option left is a desperate stand to the last man defense of Pusan.  The ghosts of the earlier Korean war appear to be with us.
译文）184 条: 你未能夺取大田(Taejon)，这是一场美国(America)及其盟友或许再也无法翻身的败仗。中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)几乎已公开其征服整个朝鲜半岛(Korean Peninsula)的计划，剩下的唯一选择，就是在釜山(Pusan)拼死抵抗、战至最后一人。上一次朝鲜战争的幽灵似乎又回来了。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your failure to retake Ho Chi Minh City has given the Western forces the justification they needed to begin a massive build up in the Southeast Asian theater. They have landed additional forces in Vietnam as well as concentrating men and equipment for an offensive towards Hanoi. Instead of protecting the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, you have exposed our nation to the gravest danger. The Prime Minister has called for your immediate removal from command.
译文）184 条: 你未能夺回胡志明市(Ho Chi Minh City)，给了西方部队所需的借口，让他们得以在东南亚(Southeast Asia)战区大举增兵。他们已在越南(Vietnam)登陆更多部队，并集结兵力装备准备向河内(Hanoi)发动攻势。你没保护好越南社会主义共和国(Socialist Republic of Vietnam)，反而把我们国家置于最危险的境地。总理已要求将你立即解职。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your failure to secure Khabarovsk is a costly blow to our efforts in the Russian Far East, and has put doubt in the mind of the Premier. If you are to quiet your detractors, you will need to do better in the future.
译文）184 条: 你未能拿下哈巴罗夫斯克(Khabarovsk)，是我军在俄罗斯远东(Russian Far East)的一场代价惨重的挫折，也让总理心中生疑。若想堵住政敌的嘴，你今后必须做得更好。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your foolhardy maneuvering around Kazan has cost you your command, and may well cost us the whole of Russia. The People’s Republic of China launched several strikes on Moscow and the armies you failed to stop in Kazan are advancing at a breakneck pace. Caught in the midst of redeployment, the Russians are in no position to stop them. Your defeat has left the President no option but to abandon all forward operations and prepare for a purely defensive stance.
译文）184 条: 你在喀山(Kazan)一带的莽撞用兵，让你丢了指挥权，也可能让我们丢掉整个俄罗斯(Russia)。中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)已对莫斯科(Moscow)发动数次打击，而你在喀山未能挡住的那几支军队正以惊人的速度推进。俄军正处在重新部署的混乱之中，根本无力阻挡。你的失利让总统别无选择，只能放弃一切前线行动，转入纯防御态势。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your foolhardy maneuvering around Kazan was a stupendous blunder that has cost you your command, and which may well cost us the whole of Russia. The People’s Republic of China launched several strikes on Moscow and the armies you failed to stop in Kazan are advancing at a breakneck pace. Caught in the midst of redeployment, the Russians are in no position to stop them. Your defeat has left the President no option but to abandon all forward operations and prepare for purely defensive operations.
译文）184 条: 你在喀山(Kazan)一带的莽撞用兵，是一场荒唐的大错，让你丢了指挥权，也可能让我们丢掉整个俄罗斯(Russia)。中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)已对莫斯科(Moscow)发动数次打击，而你在喀山未能挡住的那几支军队正以惊人的速度推进。俄军正处在重新部署的混乱之中，根本无力阻挡。你的失利让总统别无选择，只能放弃一切前线行动，转入纯防御作战。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your force is charged with the capture of Ekaterinburg and securing the rail lines running east into Siberia.
译文）184 条: 你的部队担负夺取叶卡捷琳堡(Ekaterinburg)、保障东入西伯利亚(Siberia)铁路线的任务。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your forces must advance south to recapture the cities along the Trans-Siberian Railroad and secure a flanking position at Suchan against Chinese-led forces.
译文）184 条: 你的部队必须向南推进，夺回西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)沿线的城镇，并在苏昌(Suchan)取得对以中国为首的部队的侧击位置。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your humiliating defeat at the hands of the Western forces has plunged Vietnam into a perilous dilemma: risking additional troops defending its positions in Southeast Asia, or surrendering those gains to the degenerate powers of the West. The Prime Minister cannot afford the additional risk of your incompetence. You are hereby relieved.
译文）184 条: 你在西方部队手下的耻辱失利，让越南(Vietnam)陷入两难：要么冒险投入更多兵力守住其在东南亚(Southeast Asia)的阵地，要么把这些战果拱手让给西方那些堕落的国家。总理再也承担不起你无能所带来的额外风险。你即此被解除职务。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your humiliating defeat at the hands of the Western forces has plunged the People’s Republic of China into the perilous dilemma of risking additional troops defending its positions in Indochina or surrendering those gains to the degenerate powers of the West. The Chinese High Command cannot afford the additional risk of your incompetence, and you will be transferred to our reserves in Mongolia.
译文）184 条: 你在西方部队手下的耻辱失利，让中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)陷入两难：要么冒险投入更多兵力守住其在中南半岛(Indochina)的阵地，要么把这些战果拱手让给西方那些堕落的国家。中国最高统帅部再也承担不起你无能所带来的额外风险，你将被调往我们在蒙古(Mongolia)的预备队。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your inglorious defeat at Pusan is an end to China’s bid to become the unrivaled power in Asia. The failure to win South Korea has opened the door for a major U.S. presence and weakened our positions throughout Asia. The Chinese High Command must now reconsolidate its forces. You, on the other hand, are to surrender yourself to the South Koreans in order to placate their desire for revenge.
译文）184 条: 你在釜山(Pusan)这场不光彩的失败，终结了中国想做亚洲(Asia)头号强国的图谋。没能拿下韩国(South Korea)，就等于给美国的大规模插手敞开了大门，也削弱了我们在亚洲各地的阵地。中国最高统帅部现在必须重新整编部队。至于你——得向韩国方面投降，好平息他们复仇的念头。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your loss at Almaty has made a mockery of the People’s Republic of China. Russian troops are streaming across the border into China and now the U.S. has committed its forces as well. The Premier expects you to take responsibility for this failure before you are dismissed from service.
译文）184 条: 你在阿拉木图(Almaty)的失利，让中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)成了笑柄。俄军正源源不断越过边界涌入中国，如今美国(America)也投入了兵力。总理要你在被革职之前，为这场失败承担责任。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your loss at Pusan has sent our allies into a panic, as they now doubt the strength of American power. Rumors are even circulating over the advantages of nuclear war. The world has been watching you, and your utter and complete failure could trigger the worst.
译文）184 条: 你在釜山(Pusan)的失利让我们的盟友陷入恐慌，他们如今怀疑起美国(America)实力的强弱。甚至还有关于核战争好处的流言在传。全世界都在盯着你，而你的彻底失败可能引发最坏的后果。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your loss at Pusan has sent our allies into a panic, as they now doubt the strength of American power. Rumors are even circulating over the advantages of nuclear war. The world is watching you, and any future failure could trigger the worst.
译文）184 条: 你在釜山(Pusan)的失利让我们的盟友陷入恐慌，他们如今怀疑起美国(America)实力的强弱。甚至还有关于核战争好处的流言在传。全世界都在盯着你，今后任何失败都可能引发最坏的后果。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your loss at Seoul was nothing less than the defeat of South Korea itself.  We have nothing left to do but to hang our heads in shame at the negotiating tables.
译文）184 条: 你在首尔(Seoul)的失利，不亚于韩国(South Korea)本身的败亡。我们如今除了在谈判桌前羞愧地低下头，别无他事可做。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your loss at Seoul was nothing less than the defeat of civilization. With no hope of a U.N. victory over the People’s Republic of China, the Russians have launched a limited nuclear strike on the Chinese occupational force in Vladivostok. That it was not on Chinese soil was all that prevented a full-scale nuclear exchange, but that is unlikely to hold. Priests, not commanders, are what the world needs now.
译文）184 条: 你在首尔(Seoul)的失利，不亚于文明的败亡。眼看联合国(UN)战胜中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)已无希望，俄罗斯(Russia)对符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)的中国占领军发动了一次有限核打击。弹头没有落在中国的土地上，是唯一阻止了全面核交换的原因——但这也难以持久。世界现在需要的是牧师，不是指挥官。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your loss at Seoul was nothing less was terrible, but HQ hasn't backed you up properly, and the South Koreans weren't as well prepared as we felt they would be.  I want you to fall south until you can stabilize the line further.  We're not going to roll over for the enemy.
译文）184 条: 你在首尔(Seoul)的失利确实糟糕，但总部没能给你有力支援，韩国人也不像我们以为的那样准备充分。我要你向南撤退，直到你能把战线进一步稳住。我们不会向敌人认输。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your loss at Volgograd is the worst disaster that I can think of since the Germans lost here during WWII.  But at least at that time, they were the bad guys!  The Russian people want your head, and I'm going to have to give it to them.
译文）184 条: 你在伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)的失利，是我记忆里自二战德军在此战败以来最惨重的灾难。不过至少当年，他们才是坏蛋！俄罗斯人民要你的脑袋，而我只得把它交给他们。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your loss of Ho Chi Minh City has given Western forces the justification they needed to begin a massive build up in the Southeast Asian theater. They have landed additional forces in Vietnam, and have been concentrating men and equipment for a counteroffensive in the north. Instead of protecting the People’s Republic of China, you have exposed our nation to the gravest of dangers. The Premier has called for an immediate termination of your command.
译文）184 条: 你丢掉胡志明市(Ho Chi Minh City)，给了西方部队所需的借口，让他们得以在东南亚(Southeast Asia)战区大举增兵。他们已在越南(Vietnam)登陆更多部队，并一直集结兵力装备准备在北方发动反攻。你没保护好中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)，反而把我们国家置于最危险的境地。总理已要求立即终止你的指挥权。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your masterful triumph is unparalleled and completes the rise of the People’s Republic of China as the undisputed power in Asia. As our newest member in the Chinese High Command, you are to be given control of all occupational forces from the Urals to Pusan. Well done!
译文）184 条: 你高超的胜利无与伦比，完成了中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)崛起为亚洲无可争议强国的进程。作为中国最高统帅部最新的一员，你将统辖从乌拉尔(Urals)到釜山(Pusan)的全部占领军。干得好！

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your mission is to recapture the city of Volgograd, destroying all Chinese forces in the area. This city is significant not only for its industrial infrastructure and strategic location, but for what it symbolizes to the world: freedom from Chinese oppression. Again one more critical battle must be fought in its streets. The free nations of the world are watching this battle. Failure is not an option.
译文）184 条: 你的任务是夺回伏尔加格勒(Volgograd)城，歼灭该地区所有中国部队。这座城市的重大意义，不仅在于其工业基础和战略位置，更在于它对世界所象征的东西：摆脱中国的压迫、获得自由。又要在这座城市的街巷里打一场关键的仗了。世界上的自由国家都在注视着这一战。失败不在选项之中。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your offensive in Siberia was a success and the High Command has recalled you to the Pacific Fleet. Our new Japanese allies fear long range rocket strikes from the island of Sakhalin and we have tasked you with clearing this island. Intelligence reports that there is a large Chinese army present. You are to land at Poronask under cover of our fleet and rapidly secure the entire island before the Chinese have a chance to use their rockets on the Japanese homeland.
译文）184 条: 你在西伯利亚(Siberia)的攻势大获成功，最高统帅部已把你召回太平洋舰队(Pacific Fleet)。我们新的日本(Japan)盟友担心来自萨哈林岛(Sakhalin)的远程火箭袭击，我们把肃清该岛的任务交给你。情报显示岛上有大批中国军队。你要在我舰队掩护下于波罗奈斯克(Poronask)登陆，在中国人有机会用火箭袭击日本本土之前迅速控制全岛。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your smashing the defenses at Kazan has thrown the rebel forces into chaos; and with the supply line now secured, we have the means to press the attack that will prevent the People’s Republic of China from regrouping.
译文）184 条: 你在喀山(Kazan)砸开防御，令叛军陷入混乱；补给线既已稳固，我们就有能力持续施压，让中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)无法重整旗鼓。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your spectacular victory at Singapore has decimated the Chinese forces. With our air and naval blockade now firmly in place, reinforcements for their troops in the north are slow in coming.
译文）184 条: 你在新加坡(Singapore)的辉煌胜利，把中国军队打残了。如今我们的海空封锁已稳固就位，他们在北方的部队增援难以为继。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your suprise attack near Suchan left the rebels with no hope of stopping our advance. The last remnants of the rebel army are now trying desperately to defend Vladivostok. You are to take the city and defeat the rebels for good.
译文）184 条: 你在苏昌(Suchan)附近的突袭，让叛军再无阻止我军推进的希望。叛军残部此刻正拼死防守符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)。你要夺取该城，彻底击败叛军。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your victory at Almaty has exceeded the hopes of even our most optimistic military planners. You have severely weakened the Russians and provided us with a second approach into the Urals. The Premier with excitement and confidence has insisted that you command our operations in the Urals.
译文）184 条: 你在阿拉木图(Almaty)的胜利，超出了我们最乐观的军事规划者的期望。你严重削弱了俄军，为我们提供了进入乌拉尔(Urals)的第二条通路。总理满怀兴奋与信心，坚持要由你指挥我们在乌拉尔的行动。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your victory at Astrakhan not only captured a critical strategic objective, it captured the world’s attention as well. Countries are beginning to believe it possible to put an end to the tyranny inflicted on other nations by China and are pledging full assistance instead of empty rhetoric. Even the world press seems captivated by your exploits. They have given you the name "Dragon Slayer."
译文）184 条: 你在阿斯特拉罕(Astrakhan)的胜利，不仅夺取了一个关键战略目标，也吸引了全世界的目光。各国开始相信，有可能终结中国强加于他国的暴政，于是纷纷承诺提供切实援助，而不再是空洞的辞令。就连世界媒体似乎也被你的战绩迷住了。他们给你起了个绰号——「屠龙者」(Dragon Slayer)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your victory at Irkutsk shattered Chinese resistance west of Lake Baikal. The remnants of that army has retreated behind the Mongolian border. This gives our forces the extra time they need to consolidate and bring up reinforcements. There may be no end to the supply of troops for the People's Republic of China, but the ghosts of our defeat here four years ago can now rest as you have avenged them.
译文）184 条: 你在伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)的胜利，粉碎了贝加尔湖(Lake Baikal)以西的中国抵抗。那支军队的残部已退到蒙古(Mongolia)边界之后。这为我军赢得了整合兵力、调上增援所需的额外时间。中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)的兵源或许源源不绝，但四年前我们在此惨败的冤魂如今可以安息了——你已为他们报了仇。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your victory at Irkutsk shattered Chinese resistance west of Lake Baikal. You must continue the push before the snows start falling.
译文）184 条: 你在伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)的胜利，粉碎了贝加尔湖(Lake Baikal)以西的中国抵抗。你必须赶在降雪之前继续推进。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your victory at Pusan has earned you the thanks from the South Korean President, as well as the respect of our allies. More than securing a base of operations, you have quieted the rumors of nuclear war. The world is watching you, and they are reassured by your display of American military prowess.
译文）184 条: 你在釜山(Pusan)的胜利，为你赢得了韩国(South Korea)总统的感谢，也赢得了盟友的敬重。你不仅夺得了一处作战基地，更平息了核战争的流言。全世界都在盯着你，而你对美国(America)军力的展示让他们安下心来。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your victory at Pusan has earned you the thanks from the South Korean President, as well as the respect of our allies. More than securing a base of operations, you have quieted the rumors of nuclear war. The world is watching you, and they are reassured by your display of American military prowess.  Now start marshalling forces for the full liberation of South Korea.
译文）184 条: 你在釜山(Pusan)的胜利，为你赢得了韩国(South Korea)总统的感谢，也赢得了盟友的敬重。你不仅夺得了一处作战基地，更平息了核战争的流言。全世界都在盯着你，而你对美国(America)军力的展示让他们安下心来。现在就开始集结兵力，为彻底解放韩国做准备吧。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your victory at Rangoon smashed the imperialist holdings in the western Indochina. The new popular Burmanese government sent his best wishes for your liberation of their country. They even comitted their forces to aid us in the liberation of the rest of Indochina, particularly in the Malay Peninsula.
译文）184 条: 你在仰光(Rangoon)的胜利，砸碎了帝国主义在中南半岛(Indochina)西部的据点。新成立的缅甸(Burma)人民政府为你解放他们的国家致上最美好的祝愿，甚至派出部队协助我们解放中南半岛其余地区，尤其是马来半岛(Malay Peninsula)。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Your victory at Taejon have provided us with the extra time we needed to prepare for a decisive attack to liberate Seoul.  Meanwhile Japan has pledged a significant package of economic support. The Chinese showed the world how well they could march against a weak foe, but now we will see how they are at running backwards.
译文）184 条: 你在大田(Taejon)的胜利，为我们争取到了准备解放首尔(Seoul)决定性进攻所需的额外时间。与此同时，日本(Japan)承诺了一揽子可观的经济援助。中国人向世界展示了他们打弱敌时行军多整齐，现在我们就要看看他们向后跑得怎么样。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: Europe finally was resurgent blitzing through in the most convincing show of strength thus far, with a BV attained in 7 out of 16 or so turns.  I divided my forces with two thirds in the north and one third deployed with some Russian auxiliaries in the south.  In spite of forgetting to move any of my southern units on the second turn, the northern wing sliced through the expected bottlenecks of Ekaterinaberg and the famed WWII tank factory at Uralmash next to it.  Lost my German AVLB and another (sigh) recon.  Other than that, the biggest problem we had was running out of ammunition.  My units suffered very few casualties.  The 100% air superiority helped as well.
译文）184 条: 欧洲人终于重振旗鼓，以迄今最令人信服的强势姿态一路闪击，16 个回合里用约 7 个回合拿下大胜。我把部队三分之二放在北面，三分之一与若干俄罗斯辅助部队一起部署在南面。尽管第二回合忘了调动南面的部队，北翼还是像切黄油一样穿过了叶卡捷琳堡的预期的瓶颈地带，以及旁边那座二战著名的乌拉尔机械厂坦克厂。折损了我的德国 AVLB 架桥车，还有一支侦察单位（唉）。除此之外，最大的问题是弹药告罄。我的部队伤亡极少，百分之百的制空权也帮了大忙。

# PeG 场景长段落整行译文（原文: I ignored all of the Supply Hexes, even the airfields, except for the ones on Singapore Island.  That enabled me to rapidly capture all of my primary objectvies.  I thought the AVLB would come in handy, but it didn't.  BV in 7 out of 16 turns.
